tabs.label: Femina Miss India : Info
tabs.dek: Miss India is a national beauty pageant in India that selects representatives to compete at international pageants like Miss World, Miss International and Miss United Continents.
body: In 1994, India witnessed a historic win at the International pageants, where Sushmita Sen, who was the winner of Miss India 1994, won the title of Miss Universe 1994 and Aishwarya Rai, who was the first Runner-up at Miss India 1994, won the title of Miss World 1994. After the remarkable win, the custom of crowning a single winner was discontinued and the organization decided that all the top three winners will be designated as winners with equal visibility and prizes.

Earlier, the three winners of Miss India were sent to Miss World, Miss Universe, and Miss Asia Pacific International pageants, respectively. And in 2000, three of the Miss India winners won their respective international pageants — Lara Dutta (Miss Universe), Priyanka Chopra (Miss World) and Diya Mirza (Miss Asia Pacific).However in 2002, Miss India started sending the second Runner-upto Miss Earth and later in 2010, the organization abandoned the Miss Universe franchise, and choosing the third winner to represent India in Miss International pageant. However, in 2013, Miss Universe Organisation endowed back the franchise to Miss India, and a separate pageant, Miss Diva 2013 was conducted to send a representative to Miss Universe.
Manushi Chhillar from Haryana was crowned as the winner of Femina Miss India 2017.

Femina Miss India 2016 was held on April 9’ 2016 in Mumbai, India. The magnificent grand coronation night of Femina Miss India 2016 was culminated after crowning Priyadarshini Chatterjee as Femina Miss India 2016. At the same event, Sushruthi Krishna was adjudged as first runner- up, while Pankhuri Gidwani was titled as the second runner- up.

Miss India 2015 winners are Aditi Arya, Miss India 2015, who represented India at Miss World 2015. Aafreen Vaz First Runner-up at Miss India 2015, who represented India at Miss Supranational 2015 and Vartika Singh Second Runner-up at Miss Grand Internaitonal 2015, who went on to represent India at Miss Grand International 2015

Miss India 2014 winners are Koyal Rana, Miss India 2014, who represented India at Miss World 2014, Jhataleka Malhotra, First Runner-up at Miss India 2014, who represented India at Miss International 2014 and Gail Nicole Da Silva, Second Runner-up at Miss India 2014, who went on to represent India at Miss United Continents 2014.

pieces.title: Femina Miss India
pieces.dek: Miss India is a national beauty pageant in India that selects representatives to compete at international pageants like Miss World, Miss International and Miss United Continents. The Miss India pageant is organised by Femina, a women's magazine published by Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd. From 1964 to 1975 the winner of Miss India was sent to Miss Universe and a runner up was sent to Miss Asia Pacific. Later in 1976, Miss India got the franchise of Miss World and three winners were chosen to represent India at Miss Universe, Miss World and Miss Asia Pacific.

tabs.dek: Miss Diva is a national beauty pageant held in India since 2013 and is organized by Femina Miss India Organization.
body: The third edition of Miss Diva 2015 was held on October 14' 2015 and Urvashi Rautela was crowned as the Miss Diva Universe 2015. She will represent India at the Miss Universe 2015 to be held later this year. Natasha Assadi was adjudged as the firt runner-up and Naveli Deshmukh was titled as the second runner-up.

The second edition of Miss Diva 2014 was held on October 19’ 2014, Noyonita Lodh was crowned Miss Diva Universe 2014. She represented India at Miss Universe 2014 pageant to be held in Doral, USA on January 25' 2015. She was among the Top 15 finalists. Other title winner included Alankrita Sahai – Miss Diva Earth who represented India at the Miss Earth 2014 pageant. The second runner-up of the pageant was Asha Bhat who represented India at the Miss Supranational 2014 pageant and was crowned as the winner.

The first edition of Miss Diva 2013 was held on September 5’ 2013 at Westin Mumbai Garden City, Mumbai. Manasi Moghe was crowned Miss Diva Universe 2013. Other title winners included Gurleen Grewal - Miss Diva International 2013 and Srishti Rana - Miss Diva Asia Pacific World 2013. Mansi Moghe was among the top 10 finalists at Miss Universe 2013 pageant and Shrishti Rana won Miss Asia Pacific World 2013 title.

tabs.label: Miss Earth India : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Earth India is an annual national beauty pageant that selects representatives for the Miss Earth pageant.
body: The national proprietor for the Miss Earth India pageant initially was 21-years old Nikhil Anand from Darbhanga, India. He is also the national director for Miss Tourism pageant, India. The franchise of Miss Earth India was passed on to Glamanand Entertainment Pvt. Ltd. in 2015. For the first-time in Indian pageant history, a separate pageant has been held to elect Miss Earth India. Earlier, Femina held the franchise for Miss Earth. India’s representatives to Miss Earth were elected by Femina Miss India, which was founded in 1964. The first runner up of the Femina Miss India contest was titled as “Femina Miss India Earth”, whereas the winner used to represent India at Miss World.
The new franchise holder of Miss Earth India is Pradeep Maithani.
With one Miss Earth winner (2010), two Miss Earth - Air winners (2006 and 2007) and plenty of finalists, India is considered as the fourth best performing country at Miss Earth.
The reigning Miss Earth India is Aaital Khosla, who won the title on November 4' 2015.
Alankrita Sahai won the title of Misss Earth India 2014 on October 14, 2014, when Miss Earth India was still under Femina Miss India franchise.
Ever since the inception of Miss Earth pageant, India has been an active participant, sending delegates to Miss Earth pageant, every year.

pieces.title: Miss Earth India

It is a newly formed national pageant, undertaken by the “Glamanand” organisation, with effect from the year 2015. tabs.label: Miss Indonesia : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Indonesia, also known as Miss World Indonesia, is an annual national beauty pageant in Indonesia that selects Indonesian representative for the Miss World pageant.
body: The first winner of the prestigious and coveted title of Miss Indonesia was Imelda Fransisca from Jawa Barat. She was sent to Miss ASEAN 2005 held also in Jakarta, Indonesia, in which she placed first runner-up to the eventual winner Jhezarie Javier from the Philippines.
Since 2006, the winner of Miss Indonesia has represented Indonesia at Miss World pageant, though Indonesia has not won any Miss World title till date.
Aspects that are used to assess each contestant varies from year to year.
In 2006: C2B2 - Beautiful (Cantik), Intelligent (Cerdas), Talented (Berbakat), Virtuous (Berbudi)
In 2007: BE SHE - Beautiful, Smart, Healthy, Eastern Value
From 2008 till now: MISS- Manner, Impressive, Smart, Social

The reigning Miss Indonesia 2014 is Maria Rahajeng who represented Indonesia at Miss World 2014 pageant, and was placed Top 25 at the finals besides amongst one of the five winners of 'Beauty with a Purpose. She will now crown her successor at the 2015 Miss Indonesia finals to be held on February 16' 2015.

tabs.label: Puteri Indonesia : Info
tabs.dek: Puteri Indonesia (meaning - Princess of Indonesia), aka Miss Universe Indonesia, is the annual beauty pageant in Indonesia, that selects and sends the winner to the Miss Universe international pageant.
body: Puteri Indonesia began crowning a national representative to be sent to Miss Universe from 1993, but by 1996, the winner was forced to withdraw from competing at the Miss Universe pageant by the former First Lady, Mrs. Tien Suharto who was the wife of the late second president of the Republic of Indonesia, Suharto. Puteri Indonesia winner was again sent to the Miss Universe, Miss International and Miss Supranational, after receiving support and permissions from Megawati Soekarnoputri, who was chosen as the first-ever Female President of Indonesia. In the year 2005, the first runner up of Puteri Indonesia was sent to Miss World, but it lost the franchise of the Miss World in 2006. After going through a series of hits and misses with international pageants, eventually, it was finalised that the three winners will be sent to Miss Universe, Miss International, and Miss Supranational.
The finale will be held in November 2021

Puteri Indonesia 2020, the 24th edition of Puteri Indonesia, was held on 6th March 2020 at Jakarta Convention Center in Jakarta, Indonesia. Raden Roro Ayu Maulida Putri of East Java was crowned the new queen by Frederika Alexis Cull, Puteri Indonesia 2019 at the end of the event finale. Ayu represented Indonesia at Miss Universe 2020 and placed at Top 21.

Putu Ayu Saraswati was crowned Miss International Indonesia 2020 while Jihane Almira Chedid was crowned Miss Supranational Indonesia 2020. Ayu will represent Indonesia at Miss International 2022 and Jihane placed in Top 12 at Miss Supranational 2021.

Puteri Indonesia 2019, the 23rd edition of the national pageant, was held on 8th March 2019 at Jakarta Convention Center in Jakarta, Indonesia. Frederika Alexis Cull of Jakarta SCR 1 was crowned the new queen by her predecessor Sonia Fergina Citra Puteri Indonesia 2018 of Bangka Belitung at the end of the event finale. She represented Indonesia at the Miss Universe 2019 where she placed in the Top 10.

Also at the finale, Jolene Marie Cholock-Rotinsulu was crowned Puteri Indonesia Lingkungan 2019 (Miss International Indonesia 2019) while Jesica Fitriana Martasari Alfharisi was crowned Puteri Indonesia Pariwisata 2019 (Miss Supranational Indonesia 2019). They both represented their countries at Miss International 2019 and Miss Supranational 2019 respectively where Jolene placed at Top 8 while Jesica placed as second runner-up.

Putri Indonesia 2018 was held on 9th March 2018 at Jakarta Convention Center in Jakarta, Indonesia. Sonia Fergina Citra from Bangka Belitung was crowned the new queen by her predecessor Bunga Jelitha Puteri Indonesia 2017. She placed in Top 20 at Miss Universe 2018.

Also at the finale, Vania Fitryanti Herlambang was crowned Miss International Indonesia 2018 and Wilda Octaviana Situngkir was crowned Miss Supranational Indonesia 2018. Vania placed in Top 15 at Miss International 2018 and Wilda was adjudged 3rd Runner-up at Miss Supranational 2018.

Puteri Indonesia 2017 was held on 31st March 2017 at Jakarta Convention Center, Jakarta. Bunga Jelitha of Jakarta Special Capital Region 5 was crowned the new queen by her predecessor Kezia Warouw Puteri Indonesia 2016 of North Sulawesi at the end of the event finale.

Also, Kevin Lilliana Junaedy was crowned Miss International Indonesia 2017, Karina Nadila Niab was crowned Miss Supranational Indonesia 2017 while Dea Goesti Rizkita Koswara was crowned Miss Grand Indonesia 2017. These winners represented their country at Miss International 2017, Miss Supranational 2017 and Miss Grand International 2017 respectively.
Kevin won the first Miss International crown for her country, Karina placed at Top 25 at Miss Supranational while Dea Goesti placed in Top 10 at Miss Grand International.

Puteri Indonesia 2016 was held on 19th February 2016 at Jakarta Convention Center, Jakarta, Indonesia. Kezia Warouw of North Sulawesi was crowned the new queen by Anindya Kusuma Putri, Puteri Indonesia 2015 at the end of the event finale. Kezia placed in Top 13 at Miss Universe 2016.

Felicia Hwang Yi Xin was crowned Miss International Indonesia 2016, Intan Aletrinö was crowned Miss Supranational Indonesia 2016 and Ariska Putri Pertiwi was crowned Miss Grand Indonesia 2016 at the finale. Felicia was adjudged 2nd Runner-up at Miss International 2016, Intan placed in Top 10 at Miss Supranational 2016 and Ariska won the Miss Grand International 2016 crown for her country.

Puteri Indonesia 2015, the 19th edition of the national pageant, was held on 20th February 2015 at Plenary Hall, Jakarta Convention Center, Jakarta, Indonesia. At the end of the event finale, Anindya Kusuma Putri of Central Java was crowned the new queen by her predecessor Elvira Devinamira, Puteri Indonesia 2014. Anindya placed in Top 15 at Miss Universe 2015.

Chintya Fabyola was crowned Miss International Indonesia 2015 (unplaced at Miss International 2015), Gresya Amanda Maaliwuga was crowned Miss Supranational Indonesia 2015 (Top 30 at Miss Supranational 2015) while Syarifah Olvah Bwefar Alhamid was crowned Miss Eco Indonesia 2015 (Top 16 at Miss Eco Universe 2016).

tabs.label: Miss Universe Japan : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Japan is an annual national pageant held in Japan, responsible for selecting the representative of Japan for the Miss Universe international pageant.
body: Until the year 2007, the Miss Universe Japan organization only twice managed to produce a Top 5 finalist. However, in the year 2007, when Riyo Mori won the second Miss Universe crown for Japan, the country was back in the international spotlight.

Before the establishment of Miss Universe Japan organization, the delegate to Miss Universe pageant was sent through Miss Japan. The Miss Japan pageant existed from 1952 to 1997, during which the pageant managed to produce a winner (1959) and five times top 5 finalists (1953, 1955, 1969, 1970 and 1988) at the Miss Universe pageant.

After the memorable win at the Miss Universe 2007 pageant, Japan has not been able to establish any winning moment so far. Last was in the year 2008, where Japan managed to make it to the Top 15 semi-finalists.

The reigning Miss Universe Japan is Keiko Tsuji, who was crowned as Miss Japan 2014 in Tokyo on March 18’ 2014. Keiko represented Japan at the Miss Universe 2014 international pageant, but could not make it to the Top finalists' list.
Miss Universe Japan 2015 is scheduled to be held on March 12’ 2015.

pieces.title: Miss Universe Japan
pieces.dek: Miss Universe Japan is an annual national pageant held in Japan, responsible for selecting the representative of Japan for the Miss Universe international pageant. The Miss Universe Japan was found in the year 1998 and was run by French national director Ines Ligron. The pageant was created in retort to Japan's then-recent lack of finalists at the Miss Universe pageant. Prior to 1998, the representative for Miss Universe was sent from Miss Japan pageant. Miss Universe Japan is a branch of the former Miss Japan pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Laos : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Laos is a national beauty pageant in Laos that crowns its representative to Miss Universe beauty pageant.
body: The first edition of Miss Universe Laos was held in 2017 as the country did not organize any contest before that. In 2018, the organization decided to appoint a delegate instead of organizing a pageant. The country is yet to pioneer its win in Miss Universe pageant or win a placement in the Top.

Miss Universe Laos 2019 is all set to host its grand coronation night on 24th August 2019 at the Royal Palace Hotel, Vientiane where thirty contestants will compete for the national crown and the opportunity to represent Laos in Miss Universe 2019.
The winner is yet to be crowned.

In 2018, no national pageant of Miss Universe Laos was held as the organization decided to appoint a delegate to represent Laos in Miss Universe 2018. On 23rd July 2018, On-anong Homsombath was appointed as Miss Universe Laos 2018 as she succeeded Miss Universe Laos 2017 Souphaphone Somvichith. On-anong Homsombath, First runner-up Miss Universe Laos 2017, graduated from Kaposvar University, Hungary 2017, majoring International relations.

The first edition of Miss Universe Laos i.e. Miss Universe Laos 2017 was held at Lao National Convention Center at Vientiane on 26th August 2017 where Souphaphone Somvichith was crowned the new queen and became the first ever Miss Universe Laos. She represented Laos in Miss Universe 2017. Her court included First Runner-Up – On-anong Homsombath, Second Runner-Up – Varissara May Tangsouvanh, Third Runner-Up – Souksavanh Luanglath and Fourth Runner-Up – Malisa Sidachanh.

tabs.label: Miss Malaysia Earth : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Malaysia Earth is an annual national beauty pageant held in Malaysia to select representatives for the Miss Earth pageant.
body: Miss Malaysia Earth pageant has been served as a platform to educate the contestants about the environmental issues, promote eco-tourism and create a healthy aspect of cordial relationship among the participants. The beauty pageant is organised by Blue Planet International and supported by various sponsors. Leong Hoong Kit is the Director of the pageant.

Finalists from different parts of Malaysia commit themselves to all the events and tasks that take place during the pageant week. Several activities are held throughout this pageant week, including tree-planting events, eco-tourism visitation and promotion, visitation to environmentally sustainable company, charities and workshops that promote environmental awareness. The finalists are also exposed to public relation exercises such as involving in preview shows and sponsoring visitations. They also get to perform their talent and parading on the stage with eco-friendly outfits created by them during a preview show held in Ipoh.

The winner of the pageant is bestowed the title Miss Malaysia Earth and get to represent Malaysia in the International Finals. Her runner ups are given the titles named after the other natural elements: Miss Eco-Tourism, Miss Malaysia Fire (equivalent to third runner-up), Miss Malaysia Water (second runner-up), and Miss Malaysia Air (first runner-up). The finals of Miss Malaysia Earth 2015 were held on August 9’ 2015 and Danielle Wong was crowned as the winner by the outgoing queen Renne Tan. Danielle will now represent Malaysia at the Miss Earth 2015 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Malaysia World : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Malaysia World is an annual national pageant of Malaysia that selects representatives for the Miss World pageant.
body: Datuk Anna Lim, twice international beauty queen, has been appointed as the official pageant licensee and organiser for the prestigious Miss Malaysia World since June 2013. Anna was crowned Miss Malaysia Universe 1990 and also won the title of Miss Malaysia World 2004. She was given the authorization by the chairman and chief executive officer of the Miss World Organisation Julia Morley in a simple ceremony in London.

“I want to send out the message that beauty queens are not just known for their looks but also for the contribution they’ve made for the society,” says Anna. The pageant aims at bringing contestants who can impress them with their intelligence and personality.

Dewi Liana Seriestha was crowned Miss Malaysia World 2014 and represented Malaysia at the Miss World 2014 pageant. Dewi was the winner of Talent Fast Track round at the Miss World 2014 and was also one of the Top 25 finalists. Recently, on August 29’ 2015, Dewi passed on her crown to her successor Brynn Zalina Lovett. Brynn hailing from Sabah will now represent Malaysia at the Miss World 2015 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Malaysia : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Malaysia is the annual national beauty pageant of Malaysia that selects representative of Malaysia for Miss Universe international pageant.
body: Miss Universe Malaysia is the country’s premiere pageant and Reality TV event conducted annually. Started in 1962, and revamped in 2010, it is conceptualized to provide a platform for young, ambitious Malaysian women to represent their nation on the international stage, that is Miss Universe.

Miss Universe Malaysia is the longest running pageant in Malaysia, which has crowned these women who have done Malaysia proud - Datin Josephine Fonseka, Yasmin Yusoff, Datuk Anna Lim, Elaine Daly, Andrea Fonseka, Nadine Ann Thomas, Deborah Henry, Kimberley Leggett and Carey Ng. The woman who wears the Miss Universe Malaysia crown is not just a "beauty queen" but a role model for young women and an ambassador for Malaysia on the international stage.

Malaysia has so far not been so successful at the Miss Universe pageant, with no titles to its credit. The best placement for Malaysia was in the year 1978, when Yasmin Yusoff managed to place Top 15 at the finals.
Samantha Katie was crowned as Miss Universe Malaysia 2017 at the gala finale held on 23rd February 2017.

Kiran Jassal was crowned as Miss Universe Malaysia 2016 by the outgoing titleholder, Vanessa Tevi Kumares in the glistening coronation gala held on January 30’ 2016 after beating 13 other crown contenders in the Palace of the Golden Horses Hotel.
The Miss Universe Malaysia 2015 was held on April 17' 2015. Vanessa Tevi was crowned as the winner and represent Malaysia at the Miss Universe 2015 pageant, held on December 20' 2015 in Las Vegas.

Miss Universe Malaysia 2014 was Sabrina Beneett, who was crowned the winner at the finals of the pageant held on December 19' 2013. She represented Malaysia at Miss Universe 2014 pageant held on January 25' 2015, however could not make it to the Top 10 finalists.

body: Prior to 2012, Myanmar competed in Miss International only in the year 1961, when Minnie Pu represented Myanmar at Miss International 1961

When Miss Myanmar International started in 2012, Nang Khin Zay Yar was crowned Miss Myanmar International 2012 at the inaugural edition of the event held at Myanmar Convention Center, Yangon. on March 25, 2012. She competed in Miss International 2012, and won the special award of Miss Internet.

tabs.label: Miss Myanmar World : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Myanmar World is an annual national beauty pageant that selects representatives for the Miss World pageant.
body: Miss Myanmar World pageant is organized in search of the bold, the beautiful and the talented representatives of Myanmar. The first edition of Miss Myanmar World was held on September 27’ 2014, where the very gorgeous and talented 19-years old Wyne Lay was crowned the winner. Wyne Lay is a singer, lyricist and a pianist by profession. She further went on to represent Myanmar at the Miss World 2014 pageant held in London, England and became the first Miss World Myanmar after Myanmar revived its participation at the Miss World contest.

Miss Myanmar World is an opportunity for young girls to improve themselves in various aspects which helps them in building confidence, stronger character, and profile for the future career prospects. The organization provides the contestants with the in-house training camp which helps them learn and improve their abilities in the areas of team work, social welfare interests and personal talent.

The Miss Myanmar World Oganisation selects the finalists through a two tier process. Initially an audition is organized to select the semi-finalists through personal interview. Then after a series of events and competitions, the finalists are announced. After the selection and the announcement of the final list of delegates, the contestants go through a string of training and grooming sessions to prepare them for the final gala night.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Myanmar : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Myanmar (previously known as Miss Myanmar) started in the year 2013 to select Myanmar's representative for Miss Universe international beauty pageant.
body: Prior to that, Myanmar competed in Miss Universe in the years 1959-1961, when the national pageant known as Miss Burma used to send Myanmar’s representatives to Miss Universe. However, the Miss Burma pageant survived only till 1961, as in the year 1962 the national pageant was banned by the Government. Myanmar’s representatives for Miss Universe Pageant 1959, 1960 & 1961 were Than Than Aye, Myint Myint May and Khin Myint Myint. Miss Burma 1960, Myint Myint May, was awarded with ‘Miss Amity’ at Miss Universe 1960 pageant.

In 2013, Daw Soe Yu Wai obtained the license for Miss Universe and announced Myanmar’s entry into the Miss Universe pageant once again. US-educated 25-year-old Moe Set Wine became the first Miss Universe Myanmar after the commencement of the pageant in 2013, and was selected to represent Myanmar in the Miss Universe pageant for the first time since 1961. She, however, remained unplaced at the Miss Universe 2013 pageant.
Miss Universe Myanmar 2019
Miss Universe Myanmar 2019 is scheduled to be held on 31st May 2019 with 27 provincial winners competing for the national title.
Miss Universe Myanmar 2018
Hnin Thway Yu Aung was crowned Miss Universe Myanmar 2018 on 1st October 2017 and represented Myanmar in Miss Universe 2018 held in Bangkok, Thailand.
Miss Universe Myanmar 2017

Zun Than Sin was crowned Miss Universe Myanmar 2017 on 6th October 2016 and represented Myanmar in Miss Universe 2017 held in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA. She was also the first runner-up in Miss International Myanmar 2013 pageant and Top 5 in Miss Universe Myanmar 2014.
Miss Universe Myanmar 2016

Htet Htet Htun was crowned Miss Universe 2016 on 3rd October 2015 at the finale of Miss Universe Myanmar 2015 when Miss Universe Myanmar 2015 was also crowned. She was also adjudged the second runner-up in Miss World Myanmar 2014. She represented Myanmar in Miss Universe 2016 held in Manila, Philippines and won the Best National Costume award at the finale. Her costume, which weighed 40 kilograms, featured the Shwedagon Pagoda and the Bagan temples, which represents the princess of figures of Myanmar traditional puppetry.
Miss Universe Myanmar 2015

May Barani Thaw was crowned Miss Universe Myanmar 2015 on 3rd October 2015 and went on to compete in Miss Universe 2015 which was held in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA. She was also a roommate of Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach while in Las Vegas.

She was previously adjudged the first runner-up at the Miss International Myanmar 2014 beauty pageant, and after winner withdrew from participation in Miss International 2014, she represented Myanmar at the finale of Miss International 2014, which was held in Tokyo, Japan.
Miss Universe Myanmar 2014
Sharr Htut Eaindra was crowned Miss Universe Myanmar 2014 on 26th July 2014 and represented Myanmar in Miss Universe 2014, the finale whereof was held in Miami, Florida, USA.
Miss Universe Myanmar 2013

Moe Set Wine was crowned Miss Universe Myanmar 2013 and represented Myanmar in Miss Universe 2013 beauty pageant held in Moscow, Russia. With her participation in Miss Universe, she became the first woman to represent the country in the competition since 1961.

tabs.label: Miss Nepal : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Nepal (currently known as The Hidden Treasure Miss Nepal) is an annual national pageant of Nepal held in Kathmandu, Nepal since its commencement in 1994.
body: Kathmandu Jaycees, established in 1970, organized the first Miss Nepal Beauty Pageant in 1994 on the special occasion of Kathmandu Jaycees Silver Jubilee. In 1995, to give the Miss Nepal pageant a more professional approach, senior members of Kathmandu Jaycees who were involved in organizing first Miss Nepal Pageant established The Hidden Treasure, which now annually organizes Miss Nepal Pageants.

Miss Nepal's objective rests on two pillars - personality and leadership development. The organizers are basically in search of a personality that combines beauty, brain, confidence and a positive mind and one who will be able to present Nepal as its worthy ambassador to the outside world. A strong Miss Nepal must also possess interests in empowering women, engage in social service and in promoting issues related to women.

Since 1994, every year women from age range of 19–25 years old compete on the national pageant of Miss Nepal. Contestants are chosen from across the country and they begin on a month long training & grooming course before the final event in which they participate in lectures, social work, photoshoots, interviews and etiquette lessons. On the coronation night, all the candidates engage on opening sequence, introduction speech after which the top 10 semi-finalists are chosen who then compete in an interview portion with the judges and evening gown and the 5 finalists are chosen. This is when the final question and answer round is held. At the end, the names of runners-up and winner are announced.

Miss Nepal 2016, the 21st edition of the pageant, was held on April 8' 2016. At the conclusion of the finals of Miss Nepal 2016, Asmi Shrestha was crowned the winner of Miss Nepal 2016, and awarded the title of Miss World Nepal 2016. She succeeds the outgoing queen of Miss Nepal 2015 - Evana Manandhar. Her court included Roshani Khatri - first runner-up, and Barsha Lekhi - second runner-up.

Miss Nepal 2015, the 20th edition of the pageant, was held on April 17' 2015. At the conclusion of the finals of Miss Nepal 2015, Evana Manandhar (23) was crowned the winner of Miss Nepal 2015, and awarded the title of Miss World Nepal 2015. She succeeds the outgoing queen Miss World Nepal 2014 - Subin Limbu. Her court included Dibyata Vaidya (22) - the first runner-up, and Medha Koirala (20) - the second runner-up. Shristee Bhattarai and Nishma Choudhary were the other Top 5 finalists.

Miss Nepal 2014 was held on May 2' 2014 in Nepal Academy Hall, Kathmandu. Subin Limbu was crowned Miss World Nepal 2014 and the runners-up of Miss Nepal 2014 were Prinsha Shrestha (Miss Earth Nepal 2014) and Sonie Rajbhandari (Miss International Nepal 2014). All the three winners went on to compete at their respective international pageants. Subin Limbu, who represented Nepal at Miss World 2014, could not place at the finals, though she was part of Top 10 People's Choice. Prinhsa and Sonie, who competed at Miss Earth 2014 and Miss International 2014 also could not place at the finals.

tabs.label: Binibining Pilipinas : Info
tabs.dek: Binibining Pilipinas (also known as Miss Universe Philippines), is the most popular Filipino beauty pageant of the country.
body: The pageant was intended as a prestigious fund-raising activity for projects to benefit orphans, poor families and other less fortunate members of Philippine society. The Philippines, through BPCI, has produced the country’s best beauties. It offered Philippines with four Miss Universe winners - Gloria Diaz in 1969 and Margarita Moran in 1973, Pia Wurtzbach in 2015 and Catriona Gray in 2018, Six Miss International winners - Gemma Cruz in 1964, Aurora Pijuan in 1970, Melanie Marquez in 1979, Lara Quigaman in 2005, Bea Santiago in 2013 and Kylie Verzosa in 2016 and one Miss Supranational winner, Mutya Datul Miss Supranational in 2013.

Apart from producing the country’s best beauties as representatives in various international competitions, BPCI has been a key partner and played a crucial role in nation-building, providing skills training, educational workshops, mission work, and other significant services for the marginalized sectors of the community.

During the Binibining Pilipinas contest, the candidates are judged on various levels and accordingly, a list of Special Awards has been created. There are a string of preliminary events, wherein a series of Special Awards are provided to the respective candidates. The awards are as follows-
Bb. Best in National Costume
Bb. Manila Bulletin Readers' Choice
Bb. Miss Philippine Airlines Award
Bb. Miss Cream Silk Award

The 56th edition of Binibining Pilipinas aka Binibining Pilipinas 2019 is slated to happen on 9th June 2019 at the Smart Araneta Coliseum, Quezon City, Philippines. Forty delegates are slated to compete for six titles and to represent Philippines in various international beauty pageants.

The 55th edition of Binibining Pilipinas (Binibining Pilipinas 2018) held its grand coronation night on 18th March 2018 at the Smart Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City, Philippines. Forty ladies competed for the national title as Catriona Gray was crowned Binibining Pilipinas 2018 by her predecessor Rachel Peters. Maria Ahtisa Manalo was crowned Miss International Philippines 2018 by Binibining Pilipinas International 2017 Maria Angelica de Leon, Miss Intercontinental Philippines 2017 Katarina Rodriguez crowned Karen Juanita Gallman as Miss Intercontinental Philippines 2018, Miss Supranational Philippines 2017 Chanel Olive Thomas crowned Jezha Huelar as Miss Supranational Philippines 2018 while Miss Grand Philippines 2017 Elizabeth Clenci crowned Eva Psychee Patalinjug Miss Grand Philippines 2018 and Miss Globe Philippines 2017 Nelda Ibe crowned Michele Theresa Gumabao as Miss Globe Philippines 2018.

The gala finale of Binibining Pilipinas 2017, held on 30th April 2017, concluded with the crowning of Binibini 19 Rachel Louise Peters as the winner. Binibini 15 Maria Angelica de Leon was crowned Bb Pilipinas International 2017, Binibini 22 Chanel Olive Thomas was crowned as Bb Pilipinas Supranational 2017, Binibini 39 Elizabeth Durado Clenci was announced as Bb Pilipinas Grand International 2017, Binibini 31 Katarina Sonja Rodriguez was crowned Bb Pilipinas Intercontinental 2017, and Binibini 18 Nelda Ibe was crowned Bb Pilipinas Globe 2017. Binibini 32 Charmaine Elima, and Binibini 40 Kristel Guelos finished as first and second runners-up respectively.

The 53rd edition of Binibining Pilipinas pageant 2016 was held on 17th April 2016 at the Smart Araneta Coliseum, Quezon City, Philippines. Maria Mika Maxine Medina Binibini 29 was crowned as Miss Universe Philippines 2016 (Bb Pilipinas 2016), Kylie Verzosa (Binibini 31) was crowned ‎Bb Pilipinas International 2016, Jennifer Hammond (Binibini 26) was crowned Bb Pilipinas Intercontinental, Joanna Eden (Binibini 13) was crowned ‎Bb Pilipinas Supranational 2016, Nicole Cordoves (Binibini 11) was crowned Bb Pilipinas Grand International 2016 while Bb. 28 Nichole Marie Manalo was crowned Bb. Pilipinas Globe 2016.

The 52nd edition of Binibining Pilipinas pageant 2015 was held on March 15, 2015 at the Smart Araneta Coliseum, Quezon City, Philippines. The finale concluded with the crowning of Pia Alonzo Wurtzbach as the winner. Janicel Lubina was crowned ‎Bb Pilipinas International 2015, Christi Lyn McGarry was crowned ‎Bb Pilipinas Intercontinental 2015, Rogelie Catacutan was crowned ‎Bb Pilipinas Supranational 2015 and Ann Lorraine Colis was crowned Bb Pilipinas Tourism International 2015.

pieces.title: Binibining Pilipinas
pieces.dek: Binibining Pilipinas (also known as Miss Universe Philippines), is the most popular Filipino beauty pageant of the country. The Binibining Pilipinas pageant has been responsible for selecting the representatives of the Philippines for grand International beauty pageants like - Miss Universe, Miss International and other global pageants such as Miss Supranational, and Miss Intercontinental, Miss Grand International and Miss Globe. Stella Márquez-Araneta, is a former Miss Colombia, who became a Miss Universe semi-finalist and the winner of the first Miss International beauty pageant in 1960.

tabs.label: Miss Philippines Earth : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Philippines Earth originally called “Miss Philippines” is an annual national beauty pageant held in Philippines every year that selects representatives for the Miss Earth international pageant.
body: The reigning titleholders dedicate their year to promote environmental projects and to address issues concerning the environment. The winners dedicate their year to promote environmental projects and to address issues concerning the environment. The winner will represent Philippines in Miss Earth pageant.

In the year 2001, the Carousel Production abandoned the franchise for both Beauty of the Philippines and Miss Asia Pacific International beauty contests and decided to establish a beauty pageant whose aim was to attain winners who could actively promote and get involved in the preservation of the environment and the protection of Mother Earth. As a result, the Miss Philippines Earth and Miss Earth pageants were established.

The Miss Philippines Earth pageant involves a series of preliminary competitions including swimsuit, long gown, talent competition, resort wear, cocktail wear etc. but most important is the personality and ecological and environmental intelligence during the interview round. In the Year 2008, the pageant broadened its coverage to include candidates from various provinces, cities, and municipalities.

Apart from the title, a series of special awards are also given to the deserving candidates under the categories – Miss Friendship, Trash to Class Challenge, Best in Swimsuit, Best in Evening Gown, Miss Photogenic, Best in Cultural Costume, Miss Photogenic, Miss Talent, Best Cocktail Wear, Best Resort Wear and Darling of the Press.

Karen Ibasco was crowned as Miss Philippines Earth 2017. Nellza Mortola Bautista was crowned as Miss Philippines Fire 2017, Kim De Guzman was crowned as Miss Philippines Air 2017, Vanessa Mae Castillo was crowned as Miss Philippines Eco Tourism 2017 and Jessica Marasigan was crowned as Miss Philippines Water 2017.

Miss Philippines Earth 2016 was the 16th edition of Miss Philippines Earth pageant. Initially Imelda Schweighart was crowned as the winner. Due to the controversies prior to and after Miss Earth 2016, Imelda resigned from her duties as Miss Philippines Earth. Miss Philippines Earth-Water 2016 Loren Mar Artajos assumed the responsibilities as the new Miss Philippines Earth 2016.
Miss Philippines Earth 2015 was the 15th edition of Miss Philippines Earth pageant. Angelia Gabrena Ong hailing from City of Manila was crowned Miss Philippines Earth 2015.
Miss Philippines Earth 2014 was the 14th edition of Miss Philippines Earth pageant. Jamie Herrell hailing from Cebu was crowned Miss Philippines Earth 2014.

tabs.label: Miss World Philippines : Info
tabs.dek: Miss World Philippines is an annual national beauty pageant held in the Philippines every year that selects the country’s representatives for the Miss World pageant.
body: Prior to the Miss World Philippines, the title was awarded by the Miss Republic of the Philippines pageant that continued from 1966 to 1976, then it was taken over by the Mutya ng Pilipinas (Pearl of the Philippines or Muse of the Philippines) Organization through Mutya ng Pilipinas pageant that goes on from 1977 to 1991.
The pageant is inspired by the Miss World Ltd.’s slogan “Beauty with a Purpose” and henceforth adopted the theme “Beauty in Giving.”

The reigning titleholders decided to dedicate their court year to work with charities that benefit needy children and also join movements of supporting women and children’s rights and many more social causes.
Apart from the title, a series of special awards are also given to the deserving candidates under the following categories –
Miss World Philippines 2016 is Catriona Gray. Catriona will now represent the Philippines at the Miss World 2016 pageant to be held in Washington DC on 18th December 2016.
Miss World Philippines 2015 was Hillarie Danielle Parungao. She represent the Philippines at the Miss World 2015 pageant.
Miss World Philippines 2014 was Valerie Weigmann of Legazpi City. She represented the Philippines in the Miss World 2014 held on December 14, 2014 in London and ended up in the Top 25.

tabs.label: Mutya ng Pilipinas : Info
tabs.dek: Mutya ng Pilipinas is known to be the annual National Beauty pageant held in the Philippines.
body: The organization plays a vital role in promoting Tourism, Social Responsibility, Fashion and Beauty Pageantry. The Mutya ng Pilipinas National Pageant also serves as a basis to promote everything that is beautiful in the Philippines.

Over these years, selected Overseas Filipino Communities have been strong partners of Mutya ng Pilipinas through long term arrangements, with them sending their representatives to participate in its annual pageant event.
The Mutya ng Pilipinas beauty pageant has given:
(Four) Miss Asia Pacific titles: Maria Del Carmen Ines Zaragoza(1982), Gloria Dimayacyac(1983), Lorna Legaspi (1989), and Michelle Aldana(1993).
(Three) Miss Tourism International titles: Maria Esperanza Corazon Manzano in (2000-2001), Rizzini Alexis Gomez (2012-2013), and Angeli Dione Gomez (2013-2014).
(Three) Miss Tourism Queen of the Year International titles: Sherylle Lynne Santarin(1996), Racquel Uy (1999), and Leren Mae Bautista (2015).
(One) Miss Tourism Cosmopolitan International: Barbara Salvador (2010).
(One) Miss Tourism Metropolitan International: Glennifer Perido (2014).
(One) Beauty of the World title: April Love Jordan (2009).
Maryjane de Joya became the first girl to be crowned Mutya ng Pilipinas when the pageant commenced in 1968.
Ilene Astrid de Vera was crowned as Mutya ng Pilipinas 2017.
Ganiel Akrisha Krishnan was crowned as the Mutya ng Pilipinas in 2016. She competed in Miss Asia Pacific International 2016 and placed as 2nd runner-up.

pieces.title: Mutya ng Pilipinas

tabs.label: Miss Universe Singapore : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Singapore is an annual beauty pageant held in Singapore to select the country's representative to the Miss Universe pageant.
body: The Miss Universe Singapore pageant has nurtured many fiercely intelligent and beautiful ambassadors of Singapore in the last 50 years. While the pageant has evolved over the years, at its core, it remains true to the goal of seeking a role model to champion the ideals and attributes of the modern independent Singaporean woman, who is ambitious and has a steadfast view of her ability to contribute to and make a positive impact on her community.

Singapore has been sending representatives to Miss Universe contest since 1954, and Marjorie Wee was the first Singaporean to represent Singapore in Miss Universe 1954. The first Miss Singapore was Mariani Ismail in 1951, though she did not compete in Miss Universe. Singapore has been represented at Miss Universe every year since 1966. However, Singapore has not yet managed to win any Miss Universe title.

Singapore though managed to earn two placements in Miss Universe - Kathie Lee Lee Ben was placed Top 12 (8th position) in Miss Universe 1983 and Marion Nicole Teo was placed Top 10 (9th position) in Miss Universe 1987.
Miss Universe Singapore 2016 was held on October 16' 2016 when Cheryl Chou was crowned as the winner.
Other Recent Winners of Miss Universe Singapore are -
Miss Universe Singapore 2015 - Lisa Marie White
Miss Universe Singapore 2014 - Rathi Menon
Miss Universe Singapore 2013 - Shi Lim
Cheryl Chou Miss Universe Singapore 2015

tabs.label: Miss Korea : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Korea is the oldest national Beauty Pageant in Korea, which has been held annually since 1956.
body: On March 16, 2011, however, the President of the Miss World Organization, Julia Morley, announced the launch of Miss World Korea pageant. Starting with Miss World 2011, Miss World Korea has been sending representatives from Korea to the Miss World pageant.
Each year out of about 50 girls competing for Miss Korea pageant, eight winners are selected by a panel of judges.
The First place winner ("Jin"(?)) is crowned the official Miss Korea and competes in Miss Universe.
There are two "Sun"(?) finalists, which are equivalent to the first runners-up, who go on to compete in Miss International or Miss Earth.
Finally, four "Mi" (?) finalist, which are equivalent to the second runners-up are chosen.
The reigning Miss Korea is Yoo Ye-bin, who was crowned Miss Korea 2013 on June 4, 2013 in Seoul. She will compete in Miss Universe 2014 pageant.

Historically, no representative from Korea has ever won any Miss Universe, Miss World, Miss Earth or Miss International title. However, Korea came close to winning international titles at several occasions, notably the following:
Miss Universe 1988: Jang Yoon-jeong (First Runner-up)
Miss World 1988: Choi Yeon-hee (First Runner-up)
Miss International 2000: Son Tae-young (First Runner-up)
Miss International 2009: Seo Eun-mi (First Runner-up)
The year 1988 holds special importance for Korea as both the representatives from Korea were crowned the first runner-up at Miss Universe and Miss World pageant respectively.
Miss Korea 2014 pageant finals are scheduled to be held on July 15, 2014.

tabs.label: Miss Thailand World : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Thailand World is an annual national beauty pageant held in Thailand to select representatives for the Miss World pageant.
body: BEC-Tero Entertainment Pcl earned the rights to broadcast Miss Thailand World pageant in the year 1985. The first Miss Thailand World was Parnlekha Wanmuang who was crowned in the year 1985. Thailand has had a decent performance at the Miss World pageant so far. Prathumrat Woramali, as Miss Thailand World 1989, was Thailand's representative at Miss World 1989 in Hong Kong. She won the Queen of Asia Award, and later became the 3rd runner-up Miss World 1989.

Methinee Kingpayhom, Miss Thailand World 1992 won Queen of Asia in Miss World 1992. Patinya Thongsri, Miss Thailand World 1994 was announced as Thailand’s first ever Miss Personality in Miss World 1994. Tanya Tiana Suesuntisook, Miss Thailand World 1997 won Miss Personality and was ranked as the 4th runner-up Miss World 1997. Lada Engchawadechasilp Miss Thailand World 2001 was awarded Miss Photogenic Award. The Miss Thailand World 2015 pageant is scheduled to be held on August 15’ 2015 and the winner will represent at the Miss World 2015 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Thailand : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Thailand is a national beauty pageant held in Thailand to select representatives for Miss Universe beauty pageant.
body: In the year 2000, Bangkok Broadcasting & T.V. Co., Ltd. (Channel 7) was given the rights to host the pageant, after the Miss Thailand Organization lost its license from the Miss Universe Organization. Kulthida Yenprasert was crowned the first Miss Thailand Universe in March 2000. Between 2012-2013, the name of the pageant was changed to Miss Universe Thailand and the broadcast rights were given to Royal Thai Army Radio and Television Channel 5. In 2014, the pageant moved to broadcast on Channel 3, and in 2015 the pageant moved back to broadcast on Channel7.
Miss Universe Thailand 2017 is Maria Ehren, who was crowned on 29th July 2017.

Miss Universe Thailand 2016 was Chalita Suansane, who was crowned on July 21, 2016 in Bangkok by Aniporn Chalermburanawong, Miss Universe Thailand 2015. She represented Thailand at the Miss Universe 2016 pageant in Manila placing Top 6 finalist. Thailand is a part of global major pageants.

pieces.title: Miss Universe Thailand

tabs.label: Miss Brazil : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Brazil (Miss Brasil or Miss Brasil Universo) is an annual national beauty pageant of Brazil organized since 1954, which selects representatives from Brazil to Miss Universe pageant.
body: The first ever Miss Brazil pageant was won by Maria Marta Rocha in 1954.

Brazil has won the Miss Universe title twice in history; first title winner was Iêda Maria Britto Vargas from Rio Grande do Sul in the year 1963 and another title winner was Martha Maria Vasconcellos from Bahia in the year 1968. During last three years (2011-2013), representatives from Brazil - Priscila Machado, Gabriela Markus and Jakelyne Oliveira - secured a Top 5 placement at their respective Miss Universe pageants.

The reinging Queen Miss Brazil 2014 is Melissa Gurgel who was crowned Miss Brazil 2014 at the pageant held in Centro de Eventos do Ceará,Fortaleza,Ceará. She representedd Brazil at the Miss Universe 2015 and was among the Top 15 finalists. Melissa will now crown her successor at the Miss Brazil 2015 finals.
Melissa Gurgel Miss Brazil 2014

Miss Brazil 2013, was Jakelyne Oliveira; who was crowned at the finals of Miss Brazil 2013 held in Belo Horizonte on September 28, 2013. She will now crown her successor at the finals of Miss Brazil 2014 on September 27' 2014.
(From Left to Right) Jakelyne Oliveira, Gabriela Markus and Priscila Machado

tabs.label: Miss Mundo Brasil : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Mundo Brasil (or Miss World Brazil) is a national pageant held in Brazil as an independet event since 2006 to select Brazil's official representative to Miss World pageant.
body: Miss Mundo Brasil strives for originality and socio-environmental responsibility and includes in their official activities proofs of talent, sports and fashion, and encourage the practice of philanthropy in accordance with the motto of Miss World - "Beauty with a Purpose". Miss Mundo Brazil organization is run by Henrique Fontes, director of the pageant organization.

The title of Miss Mundo Brasil creates professional and personal opportunities for its participants. It opens channels for winners to express their views on various topics in media interviews, provides opportunities for cultural enrichment, and enables them to become a role model for all generations, working tirelessly in the cause of " Beauty with a Purpose".

Prior to Miss Mundo Brasil, the representatives to Miss World from Brazil were selected from Miss Brazil/ Miss Brazil Universe contests. The first ever representative from Brazil at Miss World was Sônia Maria Campos from Pernambuco who competed in Miss World 1958, where she made it to the Top 6 finalist.
Brazil has won the Miss World crown only once in the history till date, and that was in the year 1971 when Lúcia Tavares Petterle from Rio de Janeiro was crowned Miss World 1971.
Miss Mundo Brasil 2013 was Sancler Frantz Könzen from Ilha dos Lobos, who was crowned Miss Mundo Brasil 2013 on April 6' 2013. She went on to compete in Miss World 2013 pageant, and was placed Top 6.

The reigning Miss Mundo Brasil is Julia Gama from Rio Grand do Sul, who was crowned Miss Mundo Brasil 2014 on August 9' 2014. She competed in Miss World 2014 pageant and was one of the Top 10 finalists.

tabs.label: Miss Earth Chile : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Earth Chile is an annual national pageant held in Chile to select the representative of Chile to compete at the Miss Earth pageant.
body: From 2002 till 2006, the representative of Chile to Miss Earth was selected from the pageant Miss Chile. After not sending any delegates from 2007-2009, in 2010 Miss Model & Bellezas Chilenas organization appointed the titleholder for the competition. However, from 2013, Nuestra Belleza Chile pageant came into existence that used to select the official contender of Chile for the Miss Earth pageant.

Finally, in 2015, Miss Chile Earth pageant was established, that will be selecting the country’s official representatives for the Miss Earth pageant. The finale of Miss Earth Chile 2015 was held on October 3’ 2015 and Natividad Leiva was crowned as the winner by the outgoing queen Catalina Caceres. Catalina represented Chile at the Miss Earth 2014 pageant, however was unplaced.

tabs.label: Miss Colombia : Info
tabs.dek: The Miss Colombia or Concurso Nacional de Belleza de Colombia is a national beauty pageant which started in the year 1934.Yolanda Emiliani Román was crowned the first Miss Colombia at the age of 19, and she held on to the crown till the…
body: Currently the Miss Colombia enjoys the position and reputation as one of the most prestigious fashion events in the country, besides being an entity that promotes social commitment and tourism through the beauty of Colombian women. The goal of Miss Colombia has always been to ensure the promotion of the country abroad through the beauty of Colombian women and support social work campaigns that benefit the most vulnerable citizens. The Miss Colombia pageant is held with the aim to benefit and support social causes; it extends its support to the activities of some productive sectors that promote the generation of direct and indirect jobs. Miss Colombia pageant ensures that their contestants wear national dresses manufactured in their land, under the label ‘Made in Colombia’ to promote the fashion industry. The winners of the pageant commit to the promotion of tourism, culture and heritage of Colombia.
READ ALSO: Ariadna María Gutiérrez Arévalo crowned Miss Colombia 2014

The Miss Colombia winner receives the title of Miss Colombia and represents Colombia in Miss Universe, the National Virreina, receives the title of Miss Colombia International and represents the country in Miss International, while the Princesses are responsible for participating in other competitions worldwide. Colombia has so far never managed to win the coveted 'Miss Universe' title. Colombia has won Miss International thrice till now. The three Miss International winners are as follows Maria Stella Márquez in the year 1960, Margarita Paulina Gálvez in the year 1999 and Jeymmy Vargas in the year 2004. Miss Colombia has never won the Miss Universe title.
Miss Colombia 2017 winner is Laura Gonzalez. Laura will now represent Colombia at the Miss Universe 2017 pageant.
The 2015 edition of Miss Colombia was won by Andrea Tovar. Andrea represented Colombia at Miss Universe 2016.

Miss Colombia 2014 (Concurso Nacional de Belleza de Colombia 2014) was held on November 17’ 2014 in the city of Cartagena de Indias and Ariadna María Gutiérrez Arévalo from Sucre was crowned Miss Colombia 2014. She represented Colombia at Miss Universe 2015.
Paulina Vega Dieppa was crowned Miss Colombia 2013, aand represented Colombia at the Miss Universe 2014, where she was crowned as the winner.

pieces.title: Miss Colombia
pieces.dek: The Miss Colombia or Concurso Nacional de Belleza de Colombia is a national beauty pageant which started in the year 1934.Yolanda Emiliani Román was crowned the first Miss Colombia at the age of 19, and she held on to the crown till the year 1947 as the second world war prevented the organization of the pageant to elect the new Miss Colombia. The first color transmission of the pageant was done in the year 1980 through the RCN television.

tabs.label: Miss Earth Colombia : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Earth Colombia (Spanish Miss Tierra Colombia) is the national pageant of Colombia held to crown/ select its winner to represent Colombia in Miss Earth beauty pageant held annually.
body: Until 2014, the organization used to appoint its delegate to represent Colombia at the international platform. Since 2014, though, a national pageant is held annually to crown a representative. On occasion, when the winner does not qualify (due to age) for the contest, a runner-up is sent.

Ever since the inception of Miss Earth in 2001, Colombia has sent a delegate to participate ever year. Even though the country has not won a crown till now, it has won elemental crowns for three years consecutively in 2016, 2017 and 2018 respectively.

At the grand coronation night of Miss Earth Colombia 2019 held on 22nd August 2019 at Teatro ABC in Bogotá, Colombia, Yenny Katherine Carrillo was crowned the new queen as she became the official representative of Colombia in Miss Earth 2019. She succeeds Miss Earth Colombia 2018 and Miss Earth Water 2018 Valeria Ayos Bossa.

Her elemental court included Miss Earth Colombia-Water 2019 - Betania Rojas Rincón Miss Earth Santander 2019, Miss Earth Colombia-Air 2019 - María Carolina Quintero Miss Earth Magdalena 2019, Miss Earth Colombia-Fire 2019 - María Paula Castillo Miss Earth Nariño 2019.

Miss Earth Colombia 2018 aka Miss Tierra Colombia 2018 was held on 23rd August 2019 at General Saulo Gil Ramirez Sendoya Auditorium, Bogota where Valeria Ayos Bossa, representing Old Providence, was crowned the new queen. She succeeds and was crowned by Miss Earth Colombia 2017 Juliana Franco and will now represent Colombia in Miss Earth 2018.

The elemental court of Miss Earth Colombia 2018 Valeria Ayos Bossa included Miss Earth Water Colombia 2018 – Hillary Hollmann del Prado, Miss Earth Air Colombia 2018 – Katherine Huila Prado and Miss Earth Fire Colombia 2018 – Natalia Romero.

Miss Earth Colombia 2017 finale was held on 1st September 2017 at Bogotá, Colombia where Juliana Franco was crowned as the new queen and became the official representative of Colombia in Miss Earth 2019. Juliana succeeds and was crowned by Miss Earth Colombia 2016 and Miss Earth Air 2016, Michelle Gómez.

The newly crowned queen’s court included Miss Earth Colombia Air 2017 - Lizeth Mendieta Villanueva, Miss Earth Colombia Water 2017 - Alejandra Consuegra and Miss Earth Colombia Fire 2017 - Maria Camila Medrano.

Miss Earth Colombia 2016 held its coronation night where Michelle Gomez was crowned the new queen and became the official representative of Colombia in Miss Earth 2016. She succeeds Miss Earth Colombia 2015 Estefania Muñoz Jaramillo.
Estefanía Muñoz Miss Earth Colombia 2015, Kimberly Wever Miss Earth Aruba 2015, Angelia Ong Miss Earth 2015 and Brittany Ann Payne Miss Earth Water 2015 graced the gala.

Estefania Muñoz (full name: Estefania Muñoz Jaramillo) was crowned Miss Earth Colombia 2015 as she earned the right to represent Colombia in Miss Earth 2015. She succeeds and was crowned by Miss Earth Colombia 2014 Alejandra Villafañe.

Alejandra Villafañe was crowned Miss Earth Colombia 2014 as the pageant was held for the first time in Armenia, Colombia. She succeeds and was crowned by Miss Earth Colombia 2013 Diana Carolina Ortegón Vega.

Her court included - Marlyn Mora Jimenez (represented Farallones de Cali) as Miss Earth-Air Colombia 2014, Alexandra Herrera (represented Las Hermosas) as Miss Earth Water Colombia 2014 and Alexandra Arboleda (represented Katios) as Miss Earth Fire Colombia 2014.

tabs.label: Miss Mundo Colombia : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Mundo Colombia or Miss World Colombia is an annual national beauty pageant held in Colombia to select representatives for Miss World pageant.
body: Edgar Botero, an engineer by profession, is the president of the organisation. The Executive Director is Katherine Prieto Botero who is a Dentist by profession. The other members of the organisation includes, Miss World Colombia 1995 Diana Maria Figueroa Castellanos, Miss World Colombia 1997 Gladys Buitrago, Miss World Colombia 2000 Duran Andrea Prieto, Miss World Colombia 2002 Natalia Peralta Castro, Miss World Colombia 2005 Querubin Erika, Miss World Colombia 2006 Elizabeth Loaiza Junca and Miss World Colombia 2007 Maria Jose Torrenegra Ariza.

Miss Mundo Colombia pageant has stood out for its achievement in helping the needy children. The organisation has been nominated in recent years, as the country which has worked towards solving social issues. Apart from the good looks, the pageant focuses on finding a delegate who can represent the country with its work.

Colombia has never won any Miss World title so far, but the highest placements that the country hold have been in the year 1996 and 2002. Carolina Arango Corrales in 1996 was adjudged as the first runner-up and Natalia Peralta Castro in the year 2002 was titled first runner-up. Daniela Ramos Lalinde in 2009 was placed as the sixth runner-up and aso won the Special Award for Miss World Golf. The reigning Miss Mundo Colombia is Jessica Leandra García Caicedo who represented Colombia at the Miss World 2014 pageant. However, Jessica remained unplaced.
On the eve of September 5’2015 Jessica will pass on her reign and her crown to her successor.

tabs.label: Miss Ecuador : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Ecuador is the annual national beauty pageant of Ecuador responsible as of now to select country's representatives to Miss Universe, Miss International, and Miss Supranational pageants.
body: The winner of the national pageant represents Ecuador at Miss Universe, the first and second runner-up respectively go on to compete in Miss International and Miss Supranational. The organization Miss Ecuador also selects and sends representatives to several other international pageants like Miss Grand International, Miss Intercontinental, Miss Tourism Queen International, Reina Hispanoamericana, Miss United Continents, Miss Globe International, Miss Bikini International, Miss Tourism World, Reina Nacional del Café, and several other international & regional pageants.
The Miss Ecuador organization also used to send representatives to Miss World, however since the year 2013 a separate national pageant is being held to select Ecuador's representative for Miss World.

While Ecuador has never won any Miss Universe or Miss World title till date, though it won the Miss International crown once, when Maria Fernanda Cornejo was crowned Miss International 2011 at the finals of the international pageant held on November 6' 2011 in Chengdu, China; and Miss Earth 2016 crown when Katherine Espin was crowned at the finale held in the Philippines.

Daniela Cepeda was crowned as Miss Ecuador 2017 at the conclusion of the magnificent finale held on 22nd April 2017. 21 year old Cepeda succeeds Miss Ecuador 2016 Connie Jiménez, and will now represent Ecuador at the Miss Universe 2017 pageant.
Miss Ecuador 2016, the 62nd edition of Miss Ecuador pageant, was held on March 12' 2015 in Guayaquil, Ecuador. Connie Jiménez was crowned as Miss Ecuador 2016.

Miss Ecuador 2015, the 61st edition of Miss Ecuador pageant, was held on March 14' 2015 in Guayaquil, Ecuador. Francesca Keyco Cipriani Burgos from Guayaquil was crowned as Miss Ecuador 2015 at the conclusion of the grand finale.

The reigning Miss Ecuador is Alejandra Argudo from Manabí, who was crowned Miss Ecuador 2014 on March 15, 2014 at the finals of the 60th edition of the pageant. The Miss Ecuador 2015 finals are scheduled for March 14' 2015.

pieces.dek: Miss Ecuador is the annual national beauty pageant of Ecuador responsible as of now to select country's representatives to Miss Universe, Miss International, and Miss Supranational pageants. tabs.label: Miss World Peru : Info
tabs.dek: Miss World Peru is an annual national beauty pageant that selects representatives for the Miss World beauty pageant.
body: Peru won its first Miss World crown in the year 1967, under the representation of Madeline Hartog-Bel. After 10 years, in 1977, Peru made it to the Top 15 finalists of Miss World under the representation of Maria Isabel Frias Zavala. In 1998, Mariana Larrabure de Orbegoso (Miss World Peru 1998) made it to the Top 10 finalists list. In 2002, Marina Mora Montero won the second runner-up title for Peru.
The last time Peru made a placement at the Miss World pageant was in the year 2012 when Giuliana Zevallos Roncagliolo made it to the Top 10 finalists.
Karla Chocano Tolentino was crowned as Miss Peru World 2015 on October 25’ 2014. She represented Peru at the Miss World 2015 pageant, however, remained unplaced.
Pierina Wong Mor was crowned as Miss Peru World 2016. She will now represent Peru at the Miss World 2016 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Universo Uruguay : Info
tabs.dek: Nuestra Belleza Uruguay also Miss Uruguay, is an annual national beauty pageant held in Uruguay that selects representatives for international pageants such as Miss World and Miss Grand International.
body: Aside from international pageants, the pageant also sends representatives to other minor pageants like Reina Hispanoamericana, Miss Continente Americano, Reinado Internacional del Café and Miss Maja Mundial.

The winners of Miss Universo Uruguay pageants are – (2006) Fatimih Dávila, (2007) Giannina Carla Silva, (2008) Paula Díaz, (2009) Cinthia D'Ottone, (2010) Stephany Ortega, (2011) Fernanda Semino, (2012) Camila Vezzoso, (2013) Micaela Orsi, (2014) Johana Riva, and (2015) Bianca Sánchez. All the winners competed at the Miss Universe pageant in their respective years of crowning.

The reigning Miss Universo Uruguay is Bianca Sanchez who represented Uruguay at the Miss Universe 2015 pageant. Bianca Sanchez is one of the new models of Uruguay participating in various productions by renowned designers, along with the leading models of the country. Bianca started dreaming of attaining the title of Miss Uruguay since a tender age.

The Miss Uruguay pageant was held for the first time in 1952 and became the national franchise holder for Miss Universe, Miss World, and Miss International pageants. In 2004, Miss Uruguay was renamed as Miss Universo Uruguay pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Venezuela : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Venezuela is a national beauty pageant in Venezuela that selects the country’s representatives to perform at Miss Universe.
body: The pageant is conventionally held in September, preceded by two or three months of preliminary events, including the awarding of corporate prizes. The finale of the event telecast generally lasts about four hours and is televised live across Latin America by Venevision (the largest television network of Venezuela), with edited versions to the United States and Mexico on the Univision network.

Since 2013, the national pageant has been divided into two separate pageants – Miss Venezuela that selects representatives to Miss Universe, Miss International and Miss Earth. And another one is Miss Venezuela Mundo that choose the representative to Miss World.

End number of entrants apply for the pageant each year. Some young women would try their luck for up to five or six years consecutively vying to get one of the 26 to 32 titles that will permit them to compete in the final pageant.
Miss Venezuela 2015, will be the 63 edition of the Miss Venezuela pageant is scheduled to be held on October 8, 2015 at the Estudio in Caracas, Venezuela.
At the end of the event, the reigning Miss Venezuela, Mariana Coromoto Jimenez Martinez will crown one of these 25 finalists as the winner of Miss Venezuela 2015.

tabs.label: Miss Venezuela Mundo : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Venezuela Mundo (Miss Venezuela World) is a national beauty pageant held in Venezuela since year 2013, and selects the representative of Venezuela to Miss World pageant.
body: Venezuelan businessman Osmel Sousa is the president of Miss Venezuela Mundo as well as Miss Venezuela organization.

Until Miss World 2012, the representative of Venezuela to the Miss World was chosen from the Miss Venezuela pageant (usually the first runner-up). Thereafter, Miss Venezuela pageant was split ito two events - one to send representatives to the Miss Universe, Miss International and Miss Earth, and the other to choose the country's representative to Miss World.

Miss Venezuela Mundo 2013, the first edition of the Miss Venezuela World, took place on August 10th 2013 in Study 1 Venevision. At the end of the event, Karen Soto (Miss Zulia) was crowned Miss Venezuela World 2013 who represented her country in the Miss World 2013 pageant. Karen, however, did not make it to Top 20 in Miss World 2013.

Miss Venezuela Mundo 2014 the second edition of the Miss Venezuela World pageant took place on August 2 in the city of Caracas in Venezuela. At the end of the event, Karen Soto, Miss Venezuela World 2013 crowned Debora Menicucci as her successor. Debora represented Venezuela in the Miss World 2014 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Barbados : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Barbados is a national beauty pageant of Barbados that selects delegates to represent Barbados at the Miss Universe pageant.
body: Barbados first sent a representative to the Miss Universe pageant in 1976, but is yet to crack the final stages of the competition. The country has not participated in the Miss Universe pageant since 2007, when the country was represented in Mexico by Jewel Garner.

After the death of the National Director Andy Niles in 2006 Candi Nicholls, a former member of Niles' team took over the franchise. Niles was National Director from 2003 to 2005. Between 2008 and 2015 Barbados was absentfrom the Miss Universe pageant.
In 2016, Brian Green set Miss Universe Barbados Organization with new features.
The winners of Miss Universe Barbados so far are:
1986 Roslyn Irene Williams
1987 Dawn Michelle Waithe

tabs.label: Miss Cayman Islands : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Cayman Islands is a national Beauty pageant, where the winner represents Cayman Islands at the international pageants like- Miss Universe and Miss World pageant.
body: The first Miss Cayman Islands pageant was held in the year 1977, and since then, the pageant became an annual tradition that is one of the highly anticipated national events. For more than 30 years, Cayman has successfully crowned some of the most intelligent, beautiful and poised contestants who represented the country at an international level.

The Miss Cayman Islands organization believes that the pageant is one of many traditions that helps showcase the national pride of the country and ever since its establishment, has acutely advanced into a powerful organisation. The Miss Cayman pageant provides opportunities to young women to become ambassadors locally and internationally or the Cayman Islands.

Miss Cayman Islands 2017 was held on 25th March 2017. The finale concluded with the crowning of Anika Conolly as the winner. Anika Conolly succeeds Miss Cayman Islands 2016 Monyque Brooks, and will now represent the country at the Miss Universe 2017 and Miss World 2017 pageant to be held later this year

Monyque Brooks was crowned as Miss Cayman Islands by the outgoing titleholder, Tonie Chisholm Delgadillo in the glistening coronation gala held on January 30’ 2016 after beating 7 other crown contenders at the Lions Centre, George Town, Grand Cayman. Erin Nicole Hislop was adjudged as the first runner up while Schilo Scott was titled as the second runner up at the same event.

Miss Cayman Islands 2015 was conducted after a gap of 4 years. Last the pageant was held in the year 2011, where 1987 born Lindsay Japal was crowned as the winner. Lindsay represented Cayman Islands at Miss World and Miss Universe in the year 2012. In the year 1980 and 1982, Cayman Islands was awarded as Miss Congeniality Universe, under the representation of Dealia Walter (1980) and Maureen Theresa Lewis (1982). In 1982, Maureen Theresa Lewis, from Cayman Islands, was also placed on Top 15 in the Miss World. In 1994, Anita Lilly Bush won the title of Continental Queen of Beauty at Miss World. tabs.label: Miss Universe Curacao : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Curaçao also known as Miss Universe Curaçao is an annual national beauty pageant of Curaçao that selects the country's representatives for Miss Universe international pageant.
body: Curaçao has been sending its representatives for Miss Universe since 1963, though has not won any title so far. Annemarie Braafheid who represented Curaçao at Miss Universe 1968 managed to get the highest placement for her country in the history of Miss Universe, when she became the first runner-up. Further, Anneke Dijkhuizen in 1976, Jacqueline Nelleke Josien Krijger in 1991 and Verna Angela Maria Vasquez in 1997 managed to place at the finals of the Miss Universe pageant in respective years.

The reigning queen - Miss Universe Curaçao 2014 - is Laurien Angelista who was crowned at the finals of the 2014 edition held on June 7' 2014. She competed in Miss Universe 2014 pageant held in Florida, USA this January, though could not manage to place at the finals.
Prior to Laurien, Eline de Pool was crowned as Miss Universe Curaçao 2013, and Monifa Jansen was crowned Miss Universe Curaçao 2012.
Miss Curaçao 2015 finalists have been announced.

The first runner-up and Miss International Dominicana 2013, was 21-year old Carmen Munoz, who competed in Miss International 2013, though remained unplaced. tabs.label: Mexicana Universal : Info
tabs.dek: Mexicana Universal, the national beauty pageant of Mexico, selects its representatives to Miss Universe, Miss International and Reina Hispanoamericana.
body: For every year’s competition, the organization has its requirements that the potential candidates must fulfill and vie in their respective state pageants for eligibility to participate in the pageant. The contestants are permitted to compete for their sub-national beauty titles more than once. However, this can no longer be done once they have taken part in the national event. The delegates can represent a different state as well but must have a proof of residing there for atleast twelve months before registration.

Once in the national pageant, the contestants participate in various activities and fulfil their duties as the state titleholders simultaneously. Five special awards are also given through sub challenges that provide an automatic entry to the semi-finals. If any of the titleholders are unable to fulfil their duties, the substitute takes her place to represent Mexico in the international contest.
Mexicana Universal 2019 finale will be held on 31st May 2019 where thirty two ladies will compete for the national competition.

Mexicana Universal 2018 was the first edition of national pageant under the new name held on 3rd June 2018 where Andrea Toscano of Colima was crowned the new queen. She represented Mexico in Miss Universe 2018. Fourth Runner-up Nebai Torres represented Mexico in Miss International 2018. First Runner-up Aranza Molina represented her country in Reina Hispanoamericana 2018.

Nuestra Belleza México 2017 was the 23th and the last edition of Nuestra Belleza México and was held on 11th March 2017 where Denisse Franco was crowned the new queen and represented Mexico in Miss Universe 2017. First Runner-Up Citlaly Higuera represented her country in Miss International 2017 while Karla Berumen represented in Reina Hispanomericana 2017.

pieces.title: Mexicana Universal
pieces.dek: Mexicana Universal, the national beauty pageant of Mexico, selects its representatives to Miss Universe, Miss International and Reina Hispanoamericana. tabs.label: Miss Earth Mexico : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Earth México is the annual beauty pageant of Mexico founded in 2002 to crown the country’s representative to Miss Earth pageant.
body: Even though the pageant was formed in 2002, the first national contest was not held until 2007. Prior to that, the winners were chosen by the organization through a private selection process. The first titleholder of Miss Earth México was Libna Viruega Roldan from Distrito Federal who represented Mexico in Miss Earth 2002.

Mexico is yet to win to its first ever Miss Earth pageant. The first placement of the country was in 2008 where Abigail Romo was adjudged the second runner-up in Miss Earth 2008. From 2011, the country placed in the Top 16 or Top 8 almost every year. In 2018, Melissa Flores represented Mexico in Miss Earth 2018 and was awarded the title of Miss Earth-Fire 2018 making it the first win elemental title win for her country.
Miss Earth México 2019 will host its grand coronation night on 26th May 2019 in Jardines de México in the city of Jojutla, Morelos, Mexico.

Miss Earth México 2018 was the 17th edition of the national pageant which was held on 3rd June 2018 in Colima, Mexico. Melissa Flores of Michoacán was crowned Miss Earth Mexico 2018 while Lorena González of Querétaro was adjudged Miss Earth México – Air 2018, Fernanda Contreras of Jalisco was Miss Earth Mexico – Water 2018. Alejandra Pérez of Sinaloa was adjudged Miss Earth Mexico – Fire 2018 but was later substituted by Paola Tanguma of Nuevo Leon.

Miss Earth Mexico 2017 was the 16th edition of the national pageant. The pageant was to be held on 10th September 2017 but due to 8.4 degree earthquake in Chiapas, the event was cancelled. On 8th September 2017, at a press conference, National Director Paul Marsell announced the winners of the four crowns. Karen Bustos of San Luis Potosi was awarded the title of Miss Earth Mexico 2017 while Mara Orduño of Hidalgo won Miss Earth Mexico –Air 2017, Brenda Portelinha of Estado de Mexico won Miss Earth Mexico-Water 2017 and Diana García of Baja California won Miss Earth Mexico – Fire 2017.

The 15th edition of Miss Earth Mexico, i.e Miss Earth Mexico 2016 was held on 27th August 2016 in Queretaro, Mexico. Itzel Astudillo of Chiapas was crowned Miss Earth Mexico 2016 while Yolanda Vega won Miss Earth Mexico –Air 2016, Verónica Salas of Estado de Mexico won Miss Earth Mexico – Water 2016 and Andrea Torres of Sonora won Miss Earth Mexico – Fire 2016.

The 14th edition of Miss Earth Mexico was held on 19th September 2015 in Quintana Roo, Mexico where Gladys Flores of Puebla was crowned Miss Earth Mexico 2015 by the outgoing Miss Earth Mexico 2014 Yareli Carillo. Laura Mojica of Oaxaca won Miss Earth Mexico – Air 2015, Martha Suárez of Veracruz won Miss Earth Mexico – Water 2015 and Mónica Hernández of Yucatan won Miss Earth Mexico – Fire 2015.

tabs.label: Miss World Mexico : Info
tabs.dek: Miss World Mexico, the biggest beauty pageant of Mexico is held every year to select the country’s representatives to the Miss World beauty contest.
body: The Miss World Mexico beauty pageant cherishes the journey of hundreds of gorgeous and intelligent ambassadors of the country. The pageant has seen great success through enhancing the personality of young women, who have, with their capabilities in wit and elegance, inspired the lives of many others to stand for what they truly believe in. Miss World Mexico continues to choose the ideal icon of beauty and talent for the Republic of Mexico and its citizens.

Mexico will be a contesting country at the Miss World and each year it will send in ambitious ambassadors, who could instigate a will to service for the humanly causes and make their mark not just in the beauty pageant, but also in the society. Mexico is represented in Miss World beauty pageant with undying confidence and hope to bring the crown to the country.
Ana Girault was crowned as Miss World Mexico 2016 on October 14, 2016 at the Teatro Morelos of Morelia, Michoacán.

tabs.label: Nuestra Belleza Mexico : Info
tabs.dek: Nuestra Belleza México is an annual national beauty pageant that selects representative for international pageants like Miss Universe and Miss World.
body: Aspirants vying for the title vary between the age group of 18-23 years and from all parts of Mexico. Contestants are permitted to compete for their sub-national beauty pageant titles more than once. However, once they have take part in the national event, the contestant cannot participate again. They may choose to represent a different state, but only with the proof of having resided in that particular state for at least twelve months before registration.
Denisse Franco has been crowned as Nuestra Belleza Mexico 2017 and will represent Mexico at Miss Universe 2017 pageant.
Nuestra Belleza Mexico 2015/ 2016 was Kristal Silva and represented Mexico at Miss Universe 2016 pageant.
Nuestra Belleza México 2014 is Wendolly Esparza Delgadillo and represented Mexico at the Miss Universe 2015 pageant.

pieces.title: Nuestra Belleza Mexico
pieces.dek: Nuestra Belleza México is an annual national beauty pageant that selects representative for international pageants like Miss Universe and Miss World. The pageant has been held since 1994 and has managed to deliver some fabulous contestants at international level. The Nuestra Belleza México pageant organisation works in association with Televisa and is directed by the nation’s first Miss Universe titleholder, Lupita Jones (1991). The organisation has managed to produce one Miss Universe in the year 2010 and two Miss International winners for the year 2007 and 2009.

body: The Miss Mundo Nicaragua organisation is led by Denis Martin Davila and the pageant supports in bringing up the new talents. Nicaragua has had a sluggish record at the Miss World pageant. Back in 1968, under the representation of Margine Davidson, Nicaragua was placed as the sixth runner-up. The country’s second placement was in the year 2001, under the representation of Ligia Argüello Roa. Ligia managed to bag the title of third runner-up with a Special Award of Queen of Americas.
Yumara López Miss Mundo Nicaragua 2014 represented Nicaragua at the Miss World 2014 pageant, but remained unplaced.
