tabs.label: Miss Nicaragua : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Nicaragua (or Miss Universe Nicaragua) is the national beauty pageant of Nicaragua that selects representative for the Miss Universe and Miss International, and other international pageants.
body: Since 1955, the pageant has been selecting representatives for the International pageants. The winner of Miss Nicaragua represents the country at Miss Universe, whereas the first runner up goes up to Miss International.

Miss Nicaragua was formed with the mission to strengthen the philosophy of teamwork, committed to delivering honesty and transparency to achieve results over time. Miss Nicaragua aims to promote the beauty and culture of Nicaraguan women; it also aims at promotion of Nicaraguan artists in different fields such as photography, fashion design, beauty, performing arts, among others.

After the participants are chosen, only sixteen (16) candidates are shortlisted, who further go on to represent their respective regions at the national pageant. Till date, the majority of winners for Miss Nicaragua have been from Managua.

Earlier, Miss Nicaragua used to send its representative only to the Miss Universe and Miss International pageant, however in 2013 Nicaragua made its debut at Miss Supranational pageant and in 2014, Nicaragua also sent its representative for Miss Grand International pageant. The official candidate to represent Nicaragua at the Miss Supranational & Miss Grand International is selected by Miss Nicaragua Organization.

Till date, Nicaragua has not won Miss Universe or Miss International title. The best performance of Nicaragua was in 2009, when Indiana Sanchez became second runner up at Miss Universe 2009 and also received the award for Best National Costume.

Miss Nicaragua 2017 (or Miss Universe Nicaragua 2017), was the 36th edition of Miss Nicaragua pageant, and was held on March 25’ 2017, at the Rubén Darío National Theater, Managua, Nicaragua. At the splendid finale of Miss Nicaragua 2017 held on 25th March 2017, Berenice Quezada was crowned as the winner. Berenice Quezada succeeds Miss Nicaragua 2016 Marina Jacob, and will now represent the country at the Miss Universe 2017 pageant.

Miss Nicaragua 2016 (or Miss Universe Nicaragua 2016), was the 35th edition of Miss Nicaragua pageant, and was held on March 5’ 2016, at the Rubén Darío National Theater, Managua, Nicaragua. The contest was broadcast live on VosTV. A total of twelve finalists were selected from all over Nicaragua to compete at the finals.
Marina Jacoby was crowned as the winner. At the same event, Brianny Chamorro was titled first runner-up, and Virginia Chow was adjudged second runner-up.

Miss Nicaragua 2015 (or Miss Universe Nicaragua 2015) was the 34th edition of Miss Nicaragua pageant, and was held on March 7, 2015 at the Ruben Dario National Theater, Managua, Nicaragua. The contest was broadcast live on VosTV. A total of twelve finalistswere selected from all over Nicaragua to compete at the finals.
Daniela Torres from Managua was crowned as the winner. Her court included -
Yaoska Ruiz - First runner-up and crowned Miss International Nicaragua 2015
Ruth Martinez - Second Runner-up and crowned Miss Supranational Nicaragua 2015
Gabriela Calero - Third runner-up

Miss Nicaragua 2014 was Marline Barberena, who was crowned the winner at the finals of the pageant held on March 15, 2014 at the Ruben Dario Theater. Marline represented Nicaragua at the Miss Universe 2014 pageant held on January 25, 2015, however could not make it to the Top 10 finalists. Other winners at the Miss Nicaragua 2014 were:

tabs.label: Miss Mundo de Puerto Rico : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Mundo de Puerto Rico (Miss World Puerto Rico) is an annual national beauty pageant held as an independent event since the year 1996.
body: Delia Cruz, the mother of Puerto's Rico only Miss World till date Wilnelia Merced Cruz, is the President of Miss Mundo de Puerto Rico organization and Shanira Blanco, former beauty queen and TV personality, is the current national director.

Prior to 1995, Puerto Rico's representatives at Miss World were sent from other national pageants. Puerto Rico debuted in Miss World in 1959, then was absent from 1960 to 1969. In 1970 a new organization took the responsibility of sending contestants until 1985 via castings.

Puerto Rico did not compete in Miss World from 1986 to 1988. The Miss Puerto Rico organization, directed by Anna Santisteban, obtained the Miss World franchise in 1989 and sent the first runner-up of Miss Puerto Rico to Miss World until 1995.
And in 1996, Miss Mundo de Puerto Rico was launched.
Miss Mundo de Puerto Rico 2013 is Nadyalee Torres from Caguas who was crowned as the winner on April 24' 2013. She competed in Miss World 2013 pageant and was placed Top 11.

The reigning Miss World Puerto Rico (Miss Mundo de Puerto Rico) is Genesis Davila. She was crowned at the Theater of the School of Fine Arts in Guaynabo, Puerto Rico. She represented Puerto Rico at the Miss World 2014 pageant, however was unplaced. The finals of Miss Mundo de Puerto Rico 2015 is scheduled to be held on August 8’ 2015, and the end of the coronation night, Genesis will crown her successor.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Puerto Rico : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Puerto Rico is the national beauty pageant of Puerto Rico.
body: Miss Puerto Rico pageant started in 1950 and the winner used to go to the mIss Universe pageant as an envoy of the country. The pageant was held then under the direction of Anna Santisteban. Later, in year 1996 the organization lost the Miss Universe franchise. For two years Telemundo organized the event to select the Miss Universe delegate under the name of Miss Universe Puerto Rico. The name hasn’t changed since, though from 1999 Univision Puerto Rico (then TeleOnce) obtained the franchise and renamed it "Miss Puerto Rico Universe.” After that, from 2003 to 2009 Magali Febles organized the beauty pageant. Desireé Lowry and Luisito Vigoreau obtained the franchise in 2009 and again renamed the pageant as "Miss Universe Puerto Rico."
Miss Universe Puerto Rico 2017 is Danyeshka Hernandez. She will now represent Puerto Rico at Miss Universe 2017 pageant.

Miss Universe Puerto Rico 2016 was Brenda Azaria Jiménez Hernández. Previously Kristhielee Caride was crowned during the coronation gala of the 61st edition of the Miss Universe Puerto Rico beauty pageant, but was later dethroned due to her dismissive behaviour. Brenda Jimenez was titled as the new Miss Puerto Rico 2016 on March 17’ 2016 at a ceremony held in San Juan.

tabs.label: Miss America : Info
tabs.dek: Miss America Organisation is a non-profit organization that controls and oversees the local, state, and national competition framework and hosts the annual Miss America Competition and telecast.
body: It originating started as a "bathing beauty revue" in 1921, and is now judged on competitors' talent performances and interviews in addition to their physical appearance. Miss America travels about 20,000 miles a month, changing her location every 24 to 48 hours, touring the nation and promoting her particular platform of interest.

Miss America contestants contribute tens of thousands of community service hours annually and have raised over $13 million for Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals and Miss America scholarships since 2007. The Miss America pageant is a movement of empowering young women everywhere to achieve their dreams by providing quality scholarship assistance and honouring their commitment to helping others.

With every major milestone in the nation’s history, Miss America has evolved with its society, serving as a voice for women’s empowerment when it was uncommon for women to be vocal; promoting women’s education at a time when women were discouraged from joining the workforce; and serving as a champion for Civil Rights and HIV/AIDs awareness when each were deemed controversial.

In 1954, Lee Meriwether became the first Miss America to be crowned on live television with more than 27 million viewers or 39 percent of the television audience. One of the biggest highlights of the pageant was in 2015 when the Miss America 1984 Vanessa Williams made her historic return to the Miss America stage singing “Oh How the Years Go By.” Her performance concluded with a standing ovation, as Executive Chairman Sam Haskell joined Vanessa on stage and officially welcomed her back to the Miss America family.
At the conclusion of the Miss America 2017 pageant finale held on 11th September 2016 Savvy Shields from Arkansas was crowned as the winner. Savvy succeeds Miss America 2016 Betty Cantrell.
Miss America 2016 was Miss Georgia 2015, Betty Cantrell, who was crowned on September 13, 2015, by her predecessor Kira Kazantsev (Miss America 2015).

tabs.label: Miss Teen USA : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Teen USA is a beauty pageant run by the Miss Universe Organization mainly for girls aged 14–19.
body: The pageant was first held in 1983 and has been broadcast live on CBS until 2002 and then on NBC from 2003–2007. But in March 2007, it was announced that the broadcast of the Miss Teen USA pageant on NBC had not been recommenced, and that Miss Teen USA 2007 would be the final televised event.

From 2008–15, the pageant was held at the Atlantis Paradise Island Resort, located in Nassau, Bahamas. Karlie Hay of Texas was crowned on July 30, 2016 in The Venetian Resort Hotel Casino, Las Vegas, Nevada.

Prior to the final telecast the delegates compete in the preliminary competition, which includes private interviews with the judges and a presentation show where they compete in swimsuit and evening gown.

During the final competition, the semi-finalists are announced and go on to compete in swimsuit and evening gown. From 1983 to 2002 all semi-finalists also competed in an interview competition as well as both swimsuit and evening gown, followed by one or two final interview questions. In 2003, a new format was introduced where the top fifteen competed in evening gown, the top ten competed in swimsuit and the top five competed in the final question. In 2006, the order of competition was again changed where the top fifteen competed in swimsuit and the top ten in evening gown. The latest competition format was used since 2008 the final not broadcast on TV, where the top fifteen both competed in swimsuit and evening gown, and the top five competed in the final question who all are signed up by a panel of judges.

The Miss International Beauty Pageant's motto is "Ambassadors of Peace and Beauty", showing tenderness, benevolence, friendship, beauty, intelligence, ability to take action, and, most importantly, a great international sensibility. The ultimate goal of the Miss International beauty pageant is to promote world peace, goodwill, and understanding.

Lindsay Becker from Minnesota was crowned as Miss US International 2015 at the finals held on June 25' 2015. Lindsay represented USA at the Miss International 2015 pageant. Lindsay is not the usual high heels shimmery glossy beauty, as the beauty herself tweeted, “Pageant girls aren't all high heels and lipgloss my friends. Miss Maryland and I bonded over football…”. Lindsay believes that the best part about the pageants is the opportunity that it provides to meet new people.

tabs.label: Miss USA : Info
tabs.dek: The Miss USA pageant is an annual national beauty pageant held in the US to select representative for the Miss Universe pageant.
body: Previously NBC used to broadcast the Miss USA pageant. However, in 2015 NBC decided to end their business relationship and stated that they will no longer air the event. Since 2015, the Miss USA pageant will be televised on Reelz.

In 1950, when Yolande Betbeze, winner of the rival Miss America pageant, refused to pose for publicity pictures while wearing a swimsuit, pageant sponsor Catalina decided to pull their sponsorship off the pageant and create their own competition. Donald Trump, the current owner of Miss USA, bought the pageant in the year 1996.

From 1963 until 2002, the pageant was aired on CBS. Since the inception of the pageant, eight titleholders have gone to win the Miss Universe title. In the mid-1960s, the organization established a rule that when a Miss USA wins the Miss Universe title, the first runner-up assumes the Miss USA title for the remaining year. The current Miss USA is Nia Sanchez of Nevada who was crowned on June 8, 2014 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. She went on to represent USA at the Miss Universe 2015 pageant and was titled first runner-up.
Miss USA 2016 Deshauna Barber from District of Columbia was adorned with the crown of Miss USA 2016 on the magnificent finale held on June 5’ 2016 in Las Vegas.

Miss USA 2015 Olivia Jordan from Oklahoma was crowned Miss USA 2015 at the finale held on July 12’ 2015 at Baton Rouge. Olivia represented USA at the Miss Universe 2015 pageant and was adjudged second runner-up.

Miss USA 2014 Nia Sanchez from Nevada was crowned as Miss USA 2014 at the finale held on June 8' 2014 at Baton Rouge. Nia represented USA at the Miss Universe 2014 pageant and was adjudged first runner-up.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Albania : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Albania is an annual national beauty pageant that selects representatives to the Miss Universe pageant.
body: The National Director of Miss Universe Albania is Fadil Berisha. Fadil Berisha is an Albanian-American fashion photographer living in New York. Fadil is also the official photographer of Miss Universe and Miss USA.

Since its inception, the Miss Universe Albania organisation has independently selected its representative for the Miss Universe pageant, until 2011. In 2012 Miss World Albania organizer Vera Grabocka joined forces with photographer Fadil Berisha to produce a single event to choose the local representatives for the international competitions.

In 2013, Agnesa Vuthaj, a former Miss Albania took under the National Directorship of Miss Earth Albania. And for the first time, Miss Earth Albania came in collaboration with Miss Universe Albania contest. But eventually, the Miss Universe Albania and Miss Earth Albania Organisaiton parted ways and went their separate ways.

And since then, the Miss Universe Albania Organisation has been crowning two titleholders – the main winner is sent to the Miss Universe pageant, while the first runner-up is sent to Miss World pageant.
The reigning Miss Universe Albania is Megi Luka. Megi competed at the Miss Universe 2015 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Austria : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Austria (or Miss Österreich) is a national beauty pageant for unmarried women in Austria.
body: In Miss Austria pageant finals, there are total of 18 candidates
- First placed candidates from the 9 federal pageants
- Second placed candidates from 8 federal pageants
- One participant selected through online voting
Winner of the Miss Austria pageant represents Austria in Miss World. In 2013, Ena Kadic, winner of Miss Austria 2013 was sent to Miss World 2013 pageant.

Also, since 2013 another participant of Miss Austria is nominated as Austria's representative to Miss Universe pageant. In 2013, the first runner-up of Miss Austria 2013, Doris Hofmann, represented Austria at Miss Universe 2013 pageant.

First known Miss Austria (title of the pageant unknown) pageant was held in 1929, when the Viennese girl Lisl Goldarbeiter was crowned Austria beauty queen in 1929. Other known Austrian beauty queens of the pre-World War II era were Von Grienberger in 1930, and Herta Van Haentjens in 1931.
Austria has managed to win the Miss World pageant twice - in 1969 and in 1987. Eva Reuber Staier became the first ever Austrian to be crowned Miss World in 1969.
After 18 years, Ulla Weigerstorfer became the second girl from Austria to be crowned Miss World in 1987.
Miss Austria 2014 is scheduled to be held on Jul 3' 2014.

tabs.label: Miss Belgium : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Belgium or Miss België is one of the oldest national beauty pageant held annually to select one beautiful lady to represent the country at International beauty pageants.
body: Netta Duchateau , Miss Belgium 1930 represented her country at the Big Four beauty pageants, Miss Universe and eventually won the Miss Universe 1931, following which Miss Universe was held in the beautiful country, Belgium.
SEE MISS BELGIUM 2015 CONTESTANTS PROFILE

During the World War –II, the Miss Belgium was not held for some time but soon under the leadership of Jean-Jacques Fortis the organization got back on track. In 1993 Miss Belgium was first broadcast live in Flanders and Wallonia, by the only two commercial television broadcasters of the time: VTM and RTL. Stephanie Meire was crowned as the Miss Belgium 1993 as 1.197 million people watched the show live on television.
READ ABOUT MISS BELGIUM 2015

Darline Devos, the new chairman of the organizing committee of Miss Belgium, took over from where Jean-Jacques Fortis left. , In 2007 Darline Devos signed a new television contract with RTL-TVI and SBS Belgium. She has taken Miss Belgium to new heights and made the pageant a recognized platform.

Miss Belgium has seen its share of controversies. The election of Alizee Poulicek, a native speaker of French and Czech, was even linked to the 2007 Belgian government formation. She failed to speak in Dutch, the national language of Belgium and was booed by the audience.

Anissa Blondin, the First runner up of Miss Belgium 2014 replaced Laurence Langen, the Miss Belgium 2014 winner after the Miss Belgium committee decided to take away the title from Laurence due to some personal reasons. Anissa represented Belgium at the Miss World 2014 where she failed to make her presence felt, she is now going to compete in the Miss Universe 2014 scheduled to be held on January 25, 2015.

Annelis Toros represented Belgium at Miss Universe 2015 and placed in the top fifteen during the grand finale held at Las Vegas, Nevada on 20' December 2015. Annelis’s runner-up, Leylah Alliët competed in the Miss World 2015 competition but could not make the cut.

Bogdana Trifkovic is the reigning queen - Miss Earth Bosnia and Herzegovina 2014; she was crowned as such at the finals of the 2014 edition of the pageant held on September 19' 2014. pieces.title: Miss Earth Bosnia and Herzegovina
pieces.dek: Miss Earth Bosnia & Herzegovina aka Miss Earth BiH is an annual national pageant responsible for selecting the representative of Bosnia & Herzegovina for Mis Earth pageant. pieces.title: Miss Bulgaria
pieces.dek: Miss Bulgaria (also known as Miss World Bulgaria or Mis Bulgariya) is an annual national beauty contest of Bulgaria that is responsible for selecting Bulgarian representative for Miss World international pageant. The pageant initially started in 1920s, but was discontinued during the second World War and the Communist Rule in Bulgaria. It was re-established in 1990, and has been held annually since then. The current franchisee holder for Miss World Bulgaria is Fashion and Model Agency 'Visage Models Group'.

tabs.label: Miss Croatia World : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Croatia World (also known as Miss Hrvatske or Miss Croatia) is an annual national beauty pageant held in Croatia to select a representative for the Miss World pageant.
body: Since the beginning, the Miss Croatia winners have maintained great results at the Miss World pageant. In 1993, Fani Capalija Miss Croatia World 1993 was adjudged the third runner-up at the Miss World pageant. Similarly Branka Bebic Miss Croatia 1994 and Anica Martinovic Miss Croatia 1995 were placed fourth runner-up and first runner-up respectively. However, since then, Croatia has never reached the runners-up slot and managed to be placed in the Top 15 in (1999) and Top 16 in (2008).

Miss Croatia World 2016 (also known as Miss Hrvatske 2016 or Miss Croatia 2016) was held on June 17’ 2016 at Crikvenica, Hotel Omorika. Angelica Zacchigna was crowned as the winner by the outgoing queen Maja Spahija. Angelica Zacchigna will now represent Croatia at the Miss World 2016 pageant slated to be held in Washington DC, USA later this year.

Miss Croatia World 2015 (also known as Miss Hrvatske 2015 or Miss Croatia 2015) was held on June 12’ 2015 at Crikvenica, Hotel Omorika. Maja Spahija was crowned as the winner by the outgoing queen Antonije Gogic.

Miss Croatia 2014 was Antonije Gogic who was crowned Miss Croatia on the finale held on September 18’ 2014 at Diocletian Palace, Split, Croatia. There were thirteen finalists who competed for the title - Zrinka Kucinic, Tina Omerovic, Tamara Buljevic, Stella Kolar, Selma Selimovic, Natalia Modric, Ivana Tokic, Ivana Mandaric, Hana Bašic, Brigita Levanat, Antonije Gogic, Andrea Ankovic, and Anamarija Burg.

tabs.label: Czech Miss : Info
tabs.dek: Czech Miss (or Ceská Miss) is an annual national beauty pageant of Czech Republic that selects Czech Republic's representatives to participate in international pageants.
body: Ceska Miss was established in the year 2005. Michaela Malacova, Miss CzechoSlovakia 1991 is the produce of Ceska Miss. From the year 2005 to 2009, Ceska Miss used to select one winner who used to represent the country at Miss Universe pageant, while the first runner up participated at the Miss Earth pageant. Before the creation of Ceska Miss, the official candidate for Miss Universe pageant was selected by Miss Czech Republic (or Miss Ceske Republiky ).

In the year 2010, Ceska Miss and its rival pageant Miss Ceske Republiky merged under one roof to form the current Miss Ceska and started selecting representatives to Miss Universe, Miss World and Miss Earth pageants. The Ceska Miss 2010 winner competed in Miss Universe 2010 and Ceska Miss World 2010 vied in Miss World 2010 while the first runner up competed in Miss Earth 2010 pageant. Since 2011 the pageant selects three winners: Ceska Miss, Ceska Miss World, and Ceska Miss Earth to compete in Miss Universe, Miss World, and Miss Earth respectively
The first International Pageant winner from Ceska Miss was Tereza Fajksová, who was crowned the Miss Earth 2012.
Czech Miss 2016 (or Ceská Miss) was held on April 2’ 2015. Andrea Bezdekova was crowned as Ceska Miss 2016 at the conclusion of the grand finale.
Ceska Miss 2015 was held on 28 March 2015, where, Gabriela Franková crowned Nikol Švantnerová as her successor. A total of ten finalists were selected to compete for the coveted title.

body: Denmark has so far not managed to win any Miss Universe title.
Miss Universe Denmark 2019 will be held on 7th June 2019.

Helena Heuser, who also represented Denmark in Miss World 2016, was appointed Miss Universe Denmark 2018 and represented Denmark in Miss Universe 2018 held in Bangkok, though remained unplaced at the finale.
Denmark did not compete in Miss Universe 2017.

Christina Mikkelsen was announced as the winner of Face of Denmark 2016 and was crowned Miss Universe Denmark 2016 at the finale of the pageant held on 14th May 2016. She represented Denmark in Miss Universe 2016, though remained unplaced at the finale. Subsequent to her participation in Miss Universe 2016, she was dethroned from the title of Face of Denmark 2016.

At the finale of Face of Denmark 2016, besides crowning Miss Universe Denmark 2016, Sofie Klejnstrup Nielsen was crowned as Miss Supranational Denmark 2016, Sara Skals Danielsen was crowned as Miss International Denmark 2016 and Alexandria Eissinger was crowned as Miss Earth Denmark 2016.

Cecilie Wellemberg was announced as the winner of Face of Denmark 2015 and was crowned Miss Universe Denmark 2015 at the finale held on August 15’ 2015 at AC Bella Sky Hotel, Copenhagen, Denmark. Cecile represented Denmark in Miss Universe 2015 held in Las Vegas, USA, though remained unplaced at the finale. At the same event, Turið Elinborgardóttir was crowned as Miss Earth Denmark 2015, and Mette Riis Sørensen was crowned as Miss International Denmark 2015.
Denmark did not compete in Miss Universe 2014.

tabs.label: Miss Suomi : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Suoumi aka Miss Finland is the annual beauty pageant of Finland that crowns its representatives to Miss World, Miss Universe and Miss International.
body: Held for the first time in 1931, Miss Suomi was incepted to send a winner to Miss Universe. Between 1952 to 1955, the winner of Suomen Neito went to Miss Universe where Armi Kuusela was crowned as the first Miss Universe.

Due to lack of sponsorship, the national pageant of Suomen Neito was not held In 1956 which made Finland withdraw from the competition. In 1960, Finland returned to Miss Universe with the second runner-up of Miss Suomi 1960, Maija-Leena Manninen, representing the country.

Next year, the format was changed by Miss Suomi Organization to send its winner to only, Miss Universe competition and reformatted in 1962. In 2006 Maailma Suomi beauty pageant held a separate pageant to select its winner to Miss World until 2009 when it came back to Miss Suomi 1st Princess. In some years, an appointed candidate represented her country to Miss World or Miss International.
Now the pageant follows a simple format wherein the winner is sent to Miss Universe while the first runner-up and the second runner-up is sent to Miss World and Miss International respectively.

Miss Suomi 2018 was held on 29th September 2018 where Alina Voronkova was crowned Miss Universe Finland 2018. Eevi Ihalainen and Jenny Lappalainen became the first and second runners-up respectively and official representative of Miss World 2018 and Miss International 2018.

Miss Suomi 2017 was held where Michaela Söderholm was crowned Miss Universe Finland 2017 as she became the official representative of Finland in Miss Universe 2017. Adriana Gerxhalija and Pihla Koivuniemi were adjudged as the first and second runners-up respectively as they became the official representatives to Miss World 2017 and Miss International 2017 respectively.

Miss Suomi 2016 was held on 13th May 2016 where Shirly Karvinen was crowned Miss Universe Finland 2016. Heta Sallinen and Emilia Seppänen were adjudged first and second runners-up as they became the official representative of Finland in Miss World 2016 and Miss International 2016 respectively.

Miss Suomi 2015 was held on 12th April 2015 in Helsinki where Rosa-Maria Ryyti was crowned Miss Universe Finland 2015. Carola Miller and Saara Ahlberg were adjudged as the first and second runners-up respectively as they became the official representatives to Miss World 2015 and Miss International 2015 respectively.

tabs.label: Miss Gibraltar : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Gibraltar is an annual national beauty pageant that selects the representative for the Miss World pageant.
body: Miss Gibraltar pageant is produced by Santos Productions for the Ministry of Culture at the Alameda Open Air Theatre. The first ever Miss Gibraltar contest was organised by the Vox Newspaper. Won by Viola Abudarham, the first election of Miss Gibraltar took place at a dance organised at the CFCA hall situated at the southern end of Main Street. One of the shocking facts is that the first Miss Gibraltar was married at the time she won the crown. It was only after the pageant was resumed in 1964, the rules were modified.
Gibraltar so far holds only one Miss World title to its name, which was in 2009 won by Kaiane Aldorino. Kaiane speaks both English and Spanish and enjoys playing netball and training at the gym.
Miss Gibraltar 2017 is Jodie Garcia. Jodie was crowned on 8th July 2017.
Miss Gibraltar 2016 is Kayley Mifsud. Kayley was crowned on 4th June 2016 and represented Gibraltar at the Miss World 2016 pageant.
Miss Gibraltar 2015 was Hannah Bado. She was crowned on 4th July 2015 and represented the country at Miss World 2015 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Iceland : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Iceland commenced as a separate pageant in the year 2016 to select Iceland’s representative for Miss Universe under the directorship of Jorge Esteban and Manuela Osk.
body: Prior to that, representatives for Miss Universe were selected by Miss Iceland pageant, which also selected representatives for Miss World and the last representative sent by Miss Iceland organization to Miss Universe was in the year 2009 when Ingibjörg Ragnheiður Egilsdóttir was appointed to compete in Miss Universe 2009. Iceland, thereafter, did not compete in Miss Universe pageant from 2010 to 2015, until the new franchise was established in 2016.

Arna Ýr Jónsdóttir was crowned Miss Universe Iceland 2017. Her court included Ester Elísabet Gunnarsdóttir (first runner-up), Elísa Gróa Steinþórsdóttir (second runner-up), Hulda Margrét Sigurðardóttir (third runner-up) and Dagbjört Rúriksdóttir (fourth runner-up). Arna represented Iceland in Miss Universe 2017, though remained unplaced.

Hildur Maria Leifsdóttir was crowned Miss Universe Iceland 2017. Her court included Sigrún Eva Ármannsdóttir (first runner-up), Andrea Sigurðardóttir (second runner-up), Elísa Gróa Steinþórsdóttir (third runner-up) and Thoranna Thorarins (fourth runner-up). Hildur represented Iceland in Miss Universe 2016, though remained unplaced.

tabs.label: Miss Latvia : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Latvia is an annual national beauty pageant that selects representatives for the Miss World beauty pageant.
body: Based on an agreement reached in 2015 with Ms. Fogele, the Djadenko sisters were given the exclusive rights to organize all future Miss Latvia pageants. Miss Latvia Organisation aims at bringing the beauty of Latvia to the world in the most organized manner and according to international beauty standards.

All contestants are given the unique opportunity to develop their talents, personal identity and improve their awareness of Latvia and the world through their participation in this premier event. The contestants are expected to conduct themselves towards in a dedicated manner towards their goals.
The ultimate goal of Miss Latvia title holders is to represent and promote Latvia with pride and honor in international beauty pageants throughout the world.
Miss Latvia 2016 was held on July 23’ 2016 and Linda Kinca was crowned as the winner.
Miss Latvia 2015 is Lasma Zemene who represented Latvia at the Miss World 2015 pageant, but remained unplaced.

tabs.label: Miss Malta : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Malta is a national beauty pageant held in Malta every year to select representatives for international pageants like Miss Intercontinental.
body: In the early year of its establishment, the winner used to represent the country at the Miss World pageants. However from the year 1968-2001, the organization used to send the winner to Miss Universe and the first runner-up was sent to the Miss World pageant.

Rosalie Theuma was the last Maltese representative in Miss Universe. After this, starting from the year 2003, the Miss Malta winner took part in Miss Intercontinental and managed to make it into the Top 15 semi-finalists in the year 2007 with Jasmin Schellmann.

The reigning Miss Malta is Pearl Haber Miss Malta 2014 and she represented Malta at Miss Intercontinental 2014, however was unplaced. The directorship of the organization passed on to Glow Promotions in the year 2014 when Miss Floriana - Pearl Haber won this prestigious title. Pearl will now crown her successor at the finals of the Miss Malta 2015 pageant scheduled to be held on June 6’ 2015.

tabs.label: Miss Earth Netherlands : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Earth Netherlands (aka Miss Earth Nederland / Miss Beauty of the Netherlands) is one of the most renowned national contests of the Netherlands.
body: At the national contest, along with Miss Earth Netherlands, Miss Intercontinental Netherlands and Miss Teen Netherlands are also crowned since 2018.

Miss Earth Netherlands 2019 (aka Miss Earth Nederland 2019/ Miss Beauty of the Netherlands 2019) finale is scheduled to be held on 30th August 2019 at Studio 21, Hilversum, where twelve finalists selected will compete for the title of Miss Earth Netherlands 2019 and a chance to represent Netherlands in Miss Earth 2019 international beauty pageant.
The winner is yet to be announced.

Miss Earth Netherlands 2018 (Miss Beauty of the Netherlands 2018) held its grand finale on 31st August 2018 at Studio 21 in Hilversum where Margaretha de Jong was crowned the new queen. Margaretha was crowned by Miss Earth Netherlands 2017 Faith Gennevieve.
The court of the new Miss Earth Netherlands 2018 included the crowning of Miss Intercontinental Netherlands 2018 Michelle van Sonsbeek and Miss Teen of the Netherlands 2018 Quishantely Leito.

Miss Earth Netherlands 2017 witnessed the crowning of Faith Gennevieve from Flevoland as the new queen by the outgoing Miss Earth Netherlands 2016 Deborah Van Hemert. Faith is a model by profession at Musthaves For Real and Innocence Model agency.

Miss Earth Netherlands 2016 held its coronation night on 5th June 2016 in Netherlands where Deborah van Hemert was crowned the new queen by the outgoing Miss Earth Netherlands Leena Asarfi at the conclusion of the contest. The winner Deborah van Hemert has officially earned the right to represent Netherlands at Miss Earth 2016 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Grand Netherlands : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Grand Netherlands is an annual national beauty pageant held in Netherlands that selects representatives for the Miss Grand International pageant.
body: Miss Grand Netherlands comes under the franchise of “12 Months of Beauty”, which is run by Robin and Stefan, the national directors.
“12 Months of Beauty” company is also responsible for the Miss Earth Netherlands, and Miss Eco Netherlands pageants.

The coveted crown of Miss Grand Nethelands is brilliantly designed by ace Jewellery designer Eduardo Liem of Baroqco. He has crafted the crown using eye-catching emerald and Swarovski diamonds, which gives the crown a royal and regal touch. He was inspired by the Miss Grand International crown, and also got some plentiful ideas from the old czarinas and Farah Diba’s crown.

The magnificent finale of Miss Grand Netherlands 2017, held on 26th March 2017, concluded with the crowning of 23 year old Kelly van den Dungen. Kelly succeeds Miss Grand Netherlands 2016 Floor Masselink, and will now represent Netherlands at the Miss Grand International 2017 pageant to be held in the month of October.

Miss Grand Netherlands 2016 was held on June 5’ 2016 in Netherlands. Floor Masselink was crowned as the new winner at the end of the exciting finale by the outgoing Miss Grand Netherlands, Shauny Bult.
Miss Grand Netherlands 2015 was won by Shauny Bult, who was crowned as Miss Grand Netherlands at the end of the splendid gala held in the month of June 2015.

Shauny Bult, the 23 year old model is a student of Built Environment and Real Estate from Boxtel. The beauty queen represented Netherlands at the Miss Grand International pageant, wherein she was placed among the Top 20 Finalists.

Her beautiful predecessors, Talisa Wolters and Francis Everduim, represented Netherlands in the year of 2013 and 2014. The Miss Grand International pageant was the stepping stone for the beauty queens, later the beauties went to represent Netherlands at many national and international pageants.
Talisa Wolters was placed among the top 20 semi-finalists at Miss Grand International 2013 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Nederland : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Nederland (Miss Netherlands) is the annual national beauty pageant of Netherlands that is responsible for selecting the country's representatives for international beauty pageants.
body: Prior to 1991, the national pageant was known as Miss Holland and Netherlands made its debut at Miss Universe in 1956. Since 1991, the pageant became known as Miss Netherlands, and in 2009 a new pageant system was founded as Miss Universe Nederland, with Kim Kötter (Miss Netherlands 2002) as the president. As the pageant also acquired the national franchise for Miss World in the same year, the name was changed to Miss Nederland.

From 1991 to 2009, the winner of Miss Nederland represented Netherlands both at Miss World and Miss Universe pageants. In 2010, the winner also represented Nederland at Miss Earth pageant. Since 2011, the pageant decided to select separate representatives for Miss Universe, Miss World and Miss Earth, to adhere to the different perspectives which the three pageants offer. So in the year 2011, three winners were chosen and sent to compete at the three international pageants. However, in 2012 the organization lost the Miss Earth franchise, and since then two winners Miss Universe Netherlands and Miss World Netherlands are being crowned. Since 2016, the organization only holds the franchise to Miss Universe.

Netherlands as a country has won two Miss World titles (Corine Rottschäfer - Miss World 1959 and Catharina Lodders - Miss World 1962), and one Miss Universe title (Angela Visser - Miss Universe 1989).

tabs.label: Miss World Nederland : Info
tabs.dek: Miss World Nederland is an annual national beauty pageant that selects representatives to the Miss World pageant.
body: In 1951 the Netherlands made its debut at the Miss World pageant, and in 1956 at the Miss Universe pageant. The national pageant was called as ‘Miss Holland’ from 1950 until 1990. Since that year, the winner competed at the Miss Universe, while runners-up traditionally competed at the Miss World and Miss International pageant. And later from 1991 it came to be known as "Miss Nederland" whose winner went to Miss World pageant. Between 1991-2008, the Miss Universe representatives were selected from "Miss Universe Netherlands" pageant.
In 2002 Kim Kötter was crowned as Miss Nederland and in 2009 she became the national director of the pageant.

She competed at the Miss Universe 2002 in San Juan, Puerto Rico. In that year, Miss Nederland titleholder competed at the Miss Universe pageant. In 2013 Miss Nederland Organization lost the franchise of Miss Earth. Of late, the titleholders of the Miss Nederland represent their country at the Miss Universe and Miss World pageants.

Between 1951-1955 Netherlands sent the representative to Miss World contest through Miss Holland pageant. Between1956-1990 mostly the runners-up of Miss Holland competed at the pageant. While in 1991-2008 the Miss Netherlands selected the official candidate to the Miss World pageant.
According to the Miss Holland history, the Netherlands has two Miss World winners in 1959 Corine Rottschäfer of Hoorn and 1962 Catharina Lodders of Haarlem.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Norway : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Norway or Frøken Norge, now known as Miss Universe Norway, is national beauty pageant of Norway which sends representatives to the Miss Universe pageant.
body: Miss Norway was held for first time in 1950 by Dagbladet Magazine and Aud Grenes was crowned as the first ever Miss Norway. Till 1980, the pageant was run by Dagbladet Magazine. From 1981-85, the pageant was run by Miss Norway Models Agency Inc. and then continued by Frøken Norge Corporation from 1986 - 2010.

In 2012, a new concept called Miss Universe Norway was established by the company Motivaction A/S after the application for the license for Miss Universe in Norway was approved. The same year, the Miss World Norway competition was created by organizers who took over the Miss World license.
In 1990, Mona Grudt Bittrick became the first Norwegian to capture the Miss Universe title. She remains the only Miss Universe winner from Norway till date.

Mona became the clear favorite of the judges, winning the interview and swimsuit preliminaries. During the semi-finals she won all three segments. During the 1990 Miss Universe competition, she listed herself as "The beauty queen from Hell" as a publicity stunt (since she was born in Hell, Norway. Apart from that 'hell' also means 'luck' in Norwegian)

tabs.dek: Miss Egzotica International beauty pageant is a unique beauty pageant in Poland that celebrates cultures and ethnicity.
body: The pageant has been rewarded with the European Medal and title of 'The Ambassador of Polish Economy' by the BCC, European Economic and Social Committee in Brussels and Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

The Miss Egzotica foundation supports three main causes, which are education, tolerance, and environment. It supports the education of children and also leads the promotion of the Polish Republic, Polish cultural heritage of regions as well as local communities.

Every year delegates living in Poland and with origin from several countries participate in the pageant. Girls from Cuba, Mexico, Kenya, Colombia, Senegal, Turkey, Angola, Zambia, Tanzania, Congo, Mozambique, Mongolia, Belarus, Japan, Guinea, Ethiopia, Ghana, Taiwan, Vietnam, Ukraine, Philippines, Lithuania, Kazakhstan, Brazil, Armenia, Morocco, Mongolia, Syria, Sudan, India, Nigeria, Uzbekistan, Zimbabwe, Turkmenistan, Italy, etc have competed in the pageant so far.
Miss Egzotica is also the franchisee holder for Miss Earth international pageant, and one of the delegates of Miss Egzotica is selected to represent Poland in Miss Earth pageant.
At the splendid finale of Miss Egzotica International 2017 held on 12th February 2017, Victoria Abbey (originally from Ghana) was crowned as the winner.
Miss Egzotica 2016 was Sarah Nura Osman (Sudan), while Magdalena Kucharska represented Poland at Miss Earth 2016 pageant held in the Philippines.
Miss Egzotica 2017 is scheduled to be held on Feb 12' 2017.

pieces.title: Miss Egzotica International
pieces.dek: Miss Egzotica International beauty pageant is a unique beauty pageant in Poland that celebrates cultures and ethnicity. The pageant involves girls living in Poland - from Polish as well as other origins, whether or not born in Poland. The idea is to show multi-cultural content of Poland, the variety of cultures, religions and attitudes towards life and that Poland is a cosmopolitan country, attractive in various respects, such as economy, climate, and living standards. The pageant was initiated to spread the message and knowledge to the public about unity and about different countries, problems of minorities, as well as anti-discrimination, in particular with regard to color, age, sex, belief, origin or nationality.

tabs.label: Miss Polonia : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Polonia (Miss Poland Universe) is an annual beauty pageant held in Poland to select one deserving contestant who gets the opportunity to represent Poland at the Miss Universe beauty pageant.
body: Miss Polonia started in the year 1929, and since the conceptualization of the pageant, it has been selecting stunning beauties to make the country proud at International beauty pageants. Initially Miss Polonia used to select the countries representative at all Big 4 beauty pageants, but in the year 2007, Miss World took away the franchise from Miss Polonia and gave it to Miss Polski. Since then the Miss Polonia’s winner represents Poland at Miss Universe and the runners up represent the country at Miss Earth and Miss International respectively.
ALSO SEE - MISS POLONIA 2014 CONTESTANTS PROFILE

Miss Polonia is one of the oldest national beauty pageants and has an exceptional history to it. The contestants in Miss Polonia represent their respective regions/states. They go through a fierce competition where they are judged based on beauty, intellect, talent and empathy. The winner is crowned after a careful analysis by the Jury. The viewer’s popular opinion is also taken into consideration for selecting the winner of Miss Polonia. The gala event is broadcasted live on Polish public television (TVP 2) each year; it has a viewer base of 4 to 5 million.
SEE MISS POLONIA HALL OF FAME

The winner of Miss Polonia is expected to participate in charitable work. The Miss Polonia winner participates in various campaigns such as “Against Domestic Violence”, raises awareness and funds pertaining to the problems faced by the citizens of Poland on daily basis. Miss Polonia also has the additional responsibility of promoting a healthier life style.
The reigning Miss Polonia is Marcela Chmielowska, she will be representing Poland at the Miss Universe 2014 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Portugal : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universo Portugal, the national beauty pageant was introduced in 2014.
body: Before 2014, Miss República Portuguesa (also called Miss Portugal), a national beauty pageant of the country used to send representatives to the Miss Universe pageant and other international pageants.

The country has been sending its delegates to participate in the Miss Universe beauty contest since 1960. From 2003 to 2009, Portugal did not participate at Miss Universe. Since, the beginning all the delegates have remained unplaced with only one exception, Miss Universe Portugal 2011, Laura Gonçalves of Lisbon, who successfully finished as one of the Top 10 finalists.

The reigning queen is Miss Universo Portugal 2016 Flávia Joana Brito. She was crowned in December’ 2016 by the outgoing queen Miss Universo Portugal 2015, Emília Araújo of Azores. Flávia will represent the country at Miss Universe 2016, scheduled to be held in Philippines on 30th January 2016.

Miss Universo Portugal 2015, Emília Araújo of Azores, was crowned on 13th November 2016 at the Quinta da Regaleira in Sintra by Miss Universo Portugal 2014 Patricia Da Silva. Emília represented the country at Miss Universe 2015, held in Las Vegas on 19th December 2015, but remained unplaced.

tabs.label: Miss Russia : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Russia is the annual national beauty pageant of Russia that selects representatives of Russia to two of the Big 4 international beauty pageants namely Miss Universe and Miss World.
body: Julia Kourotchkina was the winner of Miss Russia 1992, the first edition of Miss Russia pageant. She went on to represent Russia at Miss World 1992 pageant and not only did Russia debut in Miss World that year, it also went on to win that year's edition.

Since 2007, the winner of Miss Russia is being sent to both Miss Universe and Miss World. If the winner is unable to represent for any reason, the first runner up is sent in lieu. Till date, Russia has won three major international titles - Miss World 1992, Miss Universe 2002 (the winner however was later dethroned and Panama's Justine Pasek, the first runner-up, was crowned instead) and Miss World 2008.

Miss Russia 2018 finale was held on 14th April 2018 in the Concert Hall Barvikha Luxury Village, Moscow where Yulia Polyachikhina was crowned the new queen by her predecessor Polina Popova. Yulia went on to represent Russia in Miss Universe 2018. Natalya Stroeva who was adjudged as the second runner-up in Miss Russia 2018 was later appointed Miss World Russia 2018 and represented her country in Miss World 2018.

Miss Russia finale was held on 15th April 2015 in the Concert Hall Barvikha Luxury Village, Moscow where Polina Popova was crowned Miss Russia 2017 by her predecessor Yana Dobrovolskaya. She represented Russia in Miss World 2017 where she placed in the Top 10. Kseniya Alexandrova, first runner-up Miss Russia 2017, went on to represent Russia in Miss Universe 2017.

Miss Russia 2016 grand finale was held on 16th April 2016. Sofia Nikitchuk, Miss Russia 2015, crowned Yana Dobrovolskaya as her successor. Yana represented Russia in Miss World 2016 while the first runner-up Yuliana Korolkova represented Russia in Miss Universe 2016.

Miss Russia 2015 grand finale was held on 18th April 2015. Yulia Alipova, Miss Russia 2014, crowned Sofia Nikitchuk as her successor. Sofia represented Russia at Miss World 2015 pageant and was titled as the first runner-up. Along with her, the first runner-up of Miss Russia 2015 Vladislava Evtushenko represented her country in Miss Universe 2015.

Miss Russia 2014 was held in the Crocus National Exhibition Hall in Moscow on March 1, 2014. Yulia Alipova from Moscow was crowned as Miss Russia 2014 by her predecessor Elmira Abdrazakova Miss Russia 2013. She represented Russia at Miss Universe 2014.

Miss Russia 2013 was held at the Concert Hall Barvikha Luxury Village in Moscow on 2nd March 2013. Elmira Abdrazakova from Mezhdurechensk was crowned Miss Russia 2013 and was the Russian representative at Miss Universe 2013.

Miss Russia 2012 was held at the Concert Hall Barvikha Luxury Village in Moscow on 3rd March 2012. Elizaveta Golovanova from Smolensk Oblast was crowned Miss Russia. She represented Russia in Miss Universe 2012 and was placed among Top 10.

tabs.label: Miss Slovensko : Info
tabs.dek: Formed in 1993, Miss Slovakia or Miss Slovensko or Miss World Slovakia is one of the most prestigious beauty pageants of Slovakia.
body: The Miss Slovensko beauty pageant begins with a media campaign to announce the annual contest process every year. The application forms are published in selected print media for several weeks. Potential contestants are selected, who meet the criteria of the beauty pageant. These girls are divided into regional casting sections. The selected contestants then go through a complex preparation process, which includes two week long training sessions. These sessions primarily focus on choreography and voice training sessions for the finalists.

Apart from getting the opportunity to represent Slovakia at the international platform, these finalists get to experience working with renowned and go through their costume and accessory fittings, rehearsals of choreography for the final evening and work with a speech and diction coach. Each year, the winners are rewarded contracts with an agency, automobiles and exotic vacations.

Slovakia is yet to pioneer its win in Miss World pageant. The highest placement Slovakia has had in Miss World is Top 20 in Miss World 2013 where Karolína Chomisteková represented Slovakia and again Top 20 in Miss World 2016 where Kristína Cincurová was the representative.

Miss Slovensko 2019 aka Miss Slovakia 2019 was held on 27th April 2019 in Bratislava, Slovakia where Frederika Kurtulíková was crowned the new queen and became the official representative of Slovakia in Miss World 2019. Natália Hrušovská became the official representative of Slovakia in Miss Supranational 2019 while Alica Ondrášová became the official representative in Miss International 2019.

Miss Slovakia 2018 aka Miss Slovensko 2018 finale was held on 30th April 2018 where Dominika Grecová was crowned the new queen by Miss Slovensko 2017 Hanka Závodná. The first runner-up of Miss Slovensko 2018 Radka Grendová was crowned Miss International Slovakia 2018.

The 22nd edition of the Miss Slovensko aka Miss Slovakia 2017 was held on 29th April 2017 where Hanka Závodná was crowned the new queen by her predecessor Miss Slovensko 2016 Kristína Cincurová. She represented Slovakia in Miss World 2017. Petra Varaliova, first runner-up, represented Slovakia at Miss International 2017. Michaela Cmarkova, second runner-up, competed in Miss Supranational 2017.

Miss Slovakia 2016 aka Miss Slovensko 2016 was the 21st edition of Miss Slovakia pageant. The finale of Miss Slovensko 2016 was held on 29th April 2016. At the culmination of the grand coronation night, Kristína Cincurová was crowned Miss World Slovakia 2016. Michaela Menkyová was crowned Miss International Slovakia 2016 and Lenka Tekeljaková was crowned Miss Supranational Slovakia 2016.

Miss Slovakia 2015 aka Miss Slovensko 2015 was the 20th edition of Miss Slovakia pageant. The finals were held on 24th April 2015 where Lujza Straková from Banská Bystrica was crowned the winner. Petra Denkova was crowned Miss Supranational Slovakia 2015 while Barbora Bakošová was crowned Miss International Slovakia 2015.

pieces.title: Miss Slovensko
pieces.dek: Formed in 1993, Miss Slovakia or Miss Slovensko or Miss World Slovakia is one of the most prestigious beauty pageants of Slovakia. Miss Slovensko was established in 1993 after the dissolution of Czechoslovakia. From the year 1993 to 1997, the winner of Miss Slovensko went to Miss Universe and the runner-ups went to Miss World and Miss International. In the year 1996, Oklamcák Production took over the Miss Slovensko franchise. Currently the Oklamcák Production agency and TV JOJ along with the Forza Production House organize the most prestigious beauty pageant in the Slovakia, Miss Slovensko and holds the franchise of Miss World and Miss International.

body: Miss Universe Slovensekej Republic is organized and produced by Silvia Lakatosova, the last Miss Czechoslovakia titleholder and the first Slovakian representative in the history of the Miss Universe pageant. Lakatošová acquired the Miss Universe franchise in 1999 and started the first ever Miss Universe Slovenskej Republiky pageant.

The winners of Miss Universe Slovenskej Republiky since its inception are - Aneta Kuklová (1999), Miroslava Kysucká (2000), Zuzana Uhrínová Baštúrová (2001), Eva Džodlová (2002), Petra Mokrošová (2003), Zita Galgóciová (2004), Michaela Drencková (2005), Judita Hrubyová (2006), Lucia Senášiová (2007), Sandra Manáková (2008), Denisa Mendrejová (2009), Anna Amenová (2010), Dagmar Kolesárová (2011), Lubica Štepanová (2012), Jeanette Borhyová (2013) and Silvia Prochádzková (2014).
Slovakia has so far not been successful at the Miss Universe pageant, with no titles to its credit.

The reigning queen - Miss Universe Slovak Republic 2014 is - Silvia Prochadzkova. She represented Slovak Republic at Miss Universe 2014 pageant held on January 25th 2015, however could not make it to the Top 15 finalists.
The Miss Universe Slovenskej Republiky 2015 is scheduled to be held on 6th March 2015.

tabs.label: Miss World Spain : Info
tabs.dek: Miss World Spain (Miss Mundo España)is an annual national beauty pageant held in Spain to select representatives for the Miss World pageant.
body: Spain’s success at international pageants has been moderate with one Miss Universe title in 1974 and 3 Miss International titles in 1977, 1990 and 2008. They have never won a Miss World title. Also the country has made to the top 5 at the Miss World thrice, with Maria del Carmen Fernández in 1961, Gloria María Valenciano in 1978 and in 1988; Susana de la Llave Varón.

Mireia Lalaguna from Barcelona was crowned Miss World Spain 2015 (Miss Mundo España 2015) at the gala finale held at Malaga where 25 girls representing various Spanish provinces competed for the coveted title. Miss Asturias, Angela González Santamarina, was the first runner-up and Miss Islas Baleares, Natalia Ferrer Fernandez, finished as the second runner-up. Mireia succeeds Lourdes Rodríguez, the Miss World Spain 2014, and will now go on to represent Spain in the Miss World contest to be held in China in December.

Miss World Spain 2014 (or Miss Mundo España 2014) final was held on September 13’ 2014 at Anfiteatro Pepe Falomir Almela, Benicassim. Elena Ibarbia Jimenez, the Miss World Spain 2013, crowned her successor Lourdes Rodriguez as Miss World Spain 2014 at the conclusion of the pageant. However, Lourdes Rodriguez failed to place at the Miss World 2014.

tabs.label: Miss Ukraine : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Ukraine is a national Beauty pageant held in Ukraine to select Ukraine’s representative to Miss World Beauty Pageant.
body: The key provision of Miss Ukraine pageant is to give equal opportunity to all girls so that everyone can participate in the competition regardless of their colour, race, religion, or moral principles. The winner of Miss Ukraine represents her country at the Miss World. On occasion, when the winner does not qualify (due to age), a runner-up is sent. Traditionally, the court of Miss Ukraine includes a Winner, Runners-up and People's Choice Award winner.
The Organizing Committee of the contest "Miss Ukraine" runs under the motto "Natural beauty – beauty of the future”, under the directorship of Oleh Bodnarchuk.

The first national pageant winner of Miss Ukraine was an eighteen-year-old student, Olha Ovcharenko, who was also a semi-finalist in "Miss USSR" beauty pageant. She was also the first runner-up in 1990 at Miss Kiev beauty pageant.

The finale of the 26th contest "Miss Ukraine" took place in the festive atmosphere of the International Center for Culture and Arts (The October Palace) and Oleksandra Kucherenko was crowned as Miss Ukraine 2016.

pieces.title: Miss Ukraine
pieces.dek: Miss Ukraine is a national Beauty pageant held in Ukraine to select Ukraine’s representative to Miss World Beauty Pageant. The purpose of the “Miss Ukraine” Pageant has always been, and remains, popularization and growth of Ukraine’s positive image in the world. tabs.label: Miss Ukraine Universe : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Ukraine Universe is a beauty pageant that originated in the year 2006, after the Miss Ukraine Organization lost the franchise to OleksandraNikolayenko.
body: Traditionally, Ukraine was represented at Miss Universe by the winner or Runner-up of the Miss Ukraine pageant.

OleksandraNikolayenko was invited by Donald Trump to Judge the Miss Universe 2005 pageant. Natalie Glebova, Miss Universe 2005 was invited by Oleksandra to visit Ukraine to promote Miss Ukraine Universe contest in 2006. The first edition of the contest was won by Inna Tsymbalyuk.

The main goal of Miss Ukraine Universe is to find the best girl who could become the face of Ukraine. The pageant aims at bringing forth a representative who can create positive image about the country in the world.

Miss Universe 2014, the 63rd edition Miss Universe pageant, was held on 25 January 2015 at the FIU Arena of Florida International University in Doral, Florida, USA. Diana Harkusha from Ukraine represented Ukraine at the Miss Universe 2014 pageant. Diana was adjudged as the second runner-up.

Miss Ukraine Universe 2015 is scheduled to be held on October 18’ 2015, with 14 contestants competing for the coveted title. Only one will be crowned as the Miss Ukraine Universe 2015 and will get a chance to represent Ukraine at the Miss Universe 2015 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss England : Info
tabs.dek: Miss England is an annual national beauty pageant held in England to select representative for the Miss World pageant.
body: The pageant has managed to attract celebrity judges at local and national finals. There have been many celebrities who have also judged the regional selection for the contest around the country, including top glamour model Jordan, who joined the judging panel for Miss Sussex.

News of the World & "Take a Break" magazine have been official media partners to the Miss England pageant and have previously sponsored contestants over the years, writing features on them and used the winners on the front covers. Various newspapers, including the Daily Mirror, The Times, The Daily Mail and various magazines including Teen Vogue in New York and Hello! have carried stories on local and national winners.

The winner of the Miss England pageant, along with the winners of Miss Northern Ireland, Miss Scotland and Miss Wales, competes in the Miss World. The highest ranking out of these four constituency countries will then be presented with the title and the crown of Miss United Kingdom.

Since the inception of Miss England pageant, no titleholder had gone on to win any international contest. However several Miss England contestants had almost clinched an international crown for England, placing in the 1st runner up position for five times; once in Miss Universe, and twice each in Miss World (as Miss United Kingdom) and Miss Europe.
Miss Hope Valley Stephanie Hill was crowned as Miss England 2017 at the finale held at Resorts World Birmingham, on July 14, 2017. Stephanie succeeds Miss World England 2016, Elizabeth Grant.
Elizabeth Grant was crowned Miss England 2016, and represented England at Miss World 2016 pageant.
Natasha Hemmings from Weston was crowned Miss England 2015, and represented England at Miss World 2015 pageant.
Miss England 2014 was Carina Tyrrell. She was elected Miss Cambridgshire then Miss England in 2014. She represented England at the Miss World 2014 pageant and was one of the Top5 finalists.

tabs.label: Miss Universe Great Britain : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Universe Britain is an annual national beauty pageant held in Great Britain to select representatives for the Miss Universe pageant.
body: The pageant started in the year 1952 and around 30 women from the island of Great Britain and Northern Ireland competed in the pageant. The very first winner of Miss Universe Great Britain was Aileen Chase who was crowned in the year 1952. For almost four decades there was no Miss Universe Great Britain. However, from the year 1955-1990 (except in 1956), the winner of Miss England represented at the Miss Universe pageant. In 1992 Miss Great Britain Universe came back until 2000.

In 2005 the pageant came back with the name Miss Universe United Kingdom and had 30 delegates representing a subdivision of British Overseas, Crown Dependencies, England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, and Wales. In 2009 the name of the pageant was changed once again changed to Miss Universe Great Britain and has stayed the same since then.
Miss Universe Great Britain 2017 is Anna Burdzy.
Miss Universe Great Birtain 2016 was Jaime-lee Faulkner.
Miss Universe Great Britain 2015 was Nena France. Nena represented Great Britain in the Miss Universde 2015 pageant.
Miss Universe Great Britain 2014 was Grace Levy. Grace represented Great Britain in the Miss Universe 2014 pageant.

tabs.label: Miss Angola : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Angola is the national pageant of Angola.
body: Leila Lopes has been the only one Miss Universe from the country and was crowned in 2011. As far as the Miss World beauty pageant is concerned, the country has given remarkable performance there as well. The country made it to the Top 5-6 finalists in the years 2006, 2007, as well as 2008. Stiviandra Oliveira was placed at the sixth position in 2006, Micaela Reis made it to the first runner-up position in 2007 and Brigith dos Santos was adjudged as the third runner-up in 2008. All the three, Stiviandra Oliveira, Micaela Reis, and Brigith dos Santos were titled as the Queen of Africa.

The reigning queen is Luisa Baptista. She represented the province Cuando Cubango and was titled as Miss Universe Angola 2016 on 13’ December 2015 after defeating 16 other contenders. She was crowned by Miss Universe 2011, Leila Lopes, and succeeded Whitney Shoikongo. She went on to represent her country in Miss Universe 2016.

pieces.title: Miss Angola
pieces.dek: Miss Angola is the national pageant of Angola. It selects winners to compete in internationally renowned beauty pageants of the world such as Miss Universe, and Miss World. The pageant was founded in the year 1997. Angola competed at the Miss Universe beauty pageant for the first time in 1998. It has been placed in the top fifteen finalists two times consecutively in 2003 and 2004 and in 2007 the contestant could successfully make it to the Top ten finalists.

body: The first Miss Egypt contest was held in 1929. The only Miss Egypt winner who held the title of Miss World was Antigone Costanda in 1954. Between 2012-2013 the Miss Egypt pageant didn’t send any representatives to the Miss World pageant due to some internal conflict.

Under a new organization, Miss Egypt World 2016 took place on September 18th at the Intercontinental City Stars, in Cairo. Twenty-one finalists competed for the title in an event attended by several ambassadors and UN representatives. 19 years old Nadine Ossama was crowned as the winner.

body: Gabon made its international debut at Miss Earth pageant in 2009 with the participation of Marlyne Lea Ayenne at Miss Earth 2009, which was immediately followed by its debut at Miss International 2009 with the participation of Cynthia Mobumb. Three years later, Gabon started sending representatives at Miss World and Miss Universe pageants. Marie-Noëlle Ada represented Gabon at Miss World 2012, and Channa Divouvi represented Gabon at Miss Universe 2012.

On November 20' 2013, Maggaly Nguema was crowned Miss Gabon 2014. She competed at Miss Universe 2014, Miss International 2014 and Miss Supranational 2014 pageants. At the finals of the Miss Supranational 2014 pageant won by Asha Bhat from India, Maggaly was placed second runner-up.
Miss Gabon 2015 pageant is scheduled to be held on April 26' 2015.

body: Morocco made its debut at Miss World in the year 1956 but later in 1968, it stopped sending delegates to the pageant. In 1957, Morocco made its debut at Miss Universe until 1978 and in 1960 Morocco made a debut at Miss International until 1969. tabs.dek: Miss Earth South Africa is an annual national beauty pageant that selects representative for the Miss Earth beauty pageant.
body: Miss Earth South Africa is a program that aims to empower young South African women with the knowledge and platform to create a sustainable difference in the plight to combat the destruction of the natural heritage.
Miss Earth SA is a leadership programme that aims to empower young women with the knowledge and a platform to create a sustainable difference in combating the destruction of SA’s natural heritage.
The programme also helps to create an awareness of sustainable development, wildlife and the conservation of the country’s natural legacy.

South Africa has never won a Miss Earth crown. In 2007, under the representation of Bokang Montjane, the country made it to the Top 16 finalists. Again in 2009, SA made it to the Top 16 list under the representation of Chanel Grantham. 2010 marked the highest placement for South Africa in Miss Earth pageant as Nondyebo Dzingwa made it to the Top 7 finalists. The next highest placement was marked in the year 2012 when Tamerin Jardine made it to Top 8.

tabs.label: Miss South Africa : Info
tabs.dek: Miss South Africa, the national beauty pageant in South Africa, selects South African representatives to compete in two of the Big Four international beauty pageants namely, Miss World and Miss Universe.
body: The Miss South Africa organization inaugurated a new format in 2018 following which, both a Miss World South Africa and a Miss Universe South Africa were selected as representatives. The current Miss South Africa 2020 is Shudufhadzo Musida. Initially, the winner would represent South Africa at Miss World and/or Miss Universe.

Established in 1956 when Apartheid was prevalent in South Africa, the first official Miss South Africa pageant was only open to white (Caucasian) females as the winner was sent to London for the Miss World. In 1956 Norma Vorster was crowned Miss South Africa but two years later, an 18-year-old secretary from Durban, Penny Coelen, was crowned Miss South Africa 1958 who made history and won Miss World. It was not until 1977 that people of all races were allowed to compete in the Miss South Africa. Prior to that, people of colour competed in the Miss Africa South pageant, which was renamed Miss Black South Africa in 1977.

Miss South Africa 2021, the 63rd edition of Miss South Africa, is all set to be held on 16th October 2021 at the Grand West Arena, Cape Town. Shudufhadzo Musida of Limpopo will crown her successor at the end of the event finale.

Miss South Africa 2020, the 62nd edition of the Miss South Africa, was held on 24th October 2020 in The Table Bay Hotel, Cape Town. Shudufhadzo Musida of Limpopo was crowned Miss South Africa 2020 by outgoing titleholder Sasha-Lee Olivier of Gauteng. Thato Mosehle and Natasha Joubert were adjudged first and second runners-up respectively.

After their coronation, it was decided that Shudufhadzo Musida will represent South Africa at Miss World 2020 while Thato Mosehle and Natasha Joubert will represent South Africa at Miss Supranational 2021 and Miss Universe 2021 respectively.

Musida, being the winner, also received prizes in excess of 3 million rand, including a car and one-year free stay in the Miss South Africa official apartment, located in Sandton, Johannesburg. First runner-up Thato Mosehle received R250,000 while Natasha Joubert received R100,000.

Miss South Africa 2019, the 61st edition of the national pageant, was held on 9th August 2019 at the Sun Arena at Time Square in Pretoria, Gauteng. Zozibini Tunzi of Eastern Cape was crowned Miss South Africa 2019 by Miss South Africa 2018 Tamaryn Green of Western Cape. While Zozibini represented South Africa at Miss Universe 2019 (and won the Miss Universe crown), Sasha-Lee Olivier, who was adjudged first runner-up, represented her country at Miss World 2019.

Miss South Africa 2018, the 60th edition of Miss South Africa, was held on 27th May 2018 at the Sun Arena at Time Square in Pretoria. For the first time, two separate delegates were selected to represent South Africa at Miss World and Miss Universe, but only one was crowned Miss South Africa.

At the end of the event finale, Tamaryn Green was crowned Miss South Africa 2018/ Miss Universe South Africa 2018 while Runner-up Thulisa Keyi was elected Miss World South Africa 2018. Green represented South Africa at Miss Universe 2018 where she placed as first Runner-up while Keyi represented South Africa at Miss World 2018, placing in the Top 30.

Miss South Africa 2017, the 59th edition of the Miss South Africa, was held on 26th March 2017 at the Sun City Superbowl. Demi Leigh Nel-Peters was crowned Miss South Africa 2017 at the conclusion of the event finale. Demi-Leigh represented South Africa at Miss Universe 2017 and was crowned as the new Miss Universe while the 1st runner-up Adè van Heerden was crowned Miss World South Africa 2017 and competed at Miss World 2017, finishing in Top 10.

Miss South Africa 2016 was held on 19th March 2016 at the Carnival City's Big Top Arena where twelve contestants from different provinces competed for the crown. Ntandoyenkosi Kunene from Mkhondo was crowned Miss South Africa 2016 by the outgoing title holder, Liesl Laurie Miss South Africa 2015. Kunene represented South Africa at Miss Universe 2016 and Miss World 2016 pageants but remained unplaced.

The finale of Miss South Africa 2015 took place on 29th March 2015 at the Sun City Superbowl. The final was contested by 12 girls who were selected after weeks of challenges at Sun City International. Liesl Laurie from Johannesburg was crowned Miss South Africa 2015 by the outgoing title holder Zipozakhe Zokufa. Miss World 2014 Rolene Strauss attended the event, along with Penelope Coelen, Miss World 1958 and Anneline Kriel, Miss World 1974.

Miss South Africa 2014, the 59th edition of the Miss South Africa, was held on 30th March 2014 at Sun City Superbowl. Rolene Strauss was crowned Miss World South Africa 2014 who, in the December of the same year, was also crowned Miss World 2014.

After Rolene’s win, Miss South Africa 2014 first runner up Ziphozakhe Zokufa was crowned Miss South Africa 2014 and competed at Miss Universe 2014. The pageant was broadcast on DStv on Mzansi Magic and was hosted by television and radio personality Elana Afrika-Bredenkamp.

Miss South Africa 2012 was held on 9 December 2012 in Sun City, South Africa. At the end of the event finale, Marilyn Ramos from Pretoria was crowned the new queen by Miss South Africa 2012 Melinda Bam. Ramos represented South Africa at Miss Universe 2013 and Miss World 2013 but remained unplaced.

Miss South Africa 2011 was held on 11 December 2011 in Sun City, South Africa. Melinda Bam was crowned Miss South Africa 2011 by the outgoing title holder Bokang Montjane from Johannesburg. She represented South Africa at South Africa at Miss Universe 2012. Although she was supposed to participate in Miss World 2012 as well but could not because if a contestant reaches the top three of the pageant she is not permitted to enter Miss Universe. The 1st princess Remona Moodley represented South Africa at Miss World 2012 instead.

tabs.label: Miss Tunisie : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Tunisie (or Miss Tunisia) is the annual national beauty pageant in Tunisia, that is responsible for selecting the country's representative for Miss World and Miss International pageants.
body: Later in 1996, the President of Association TEJ, the present organizers of the pageant, Aida Antar revived the defunct Miss Tunisie contest. Though the pageant was revived, it was only in 2013 that Tunisia started sending representatives for international pageants. Heba Talmoudi, the Miss Tunisie 2013, represented Tunisia at Miss World 2013 held in Indonesia, marking the return of Tunisia at Miss World after a gap of 25 years.

In 2014, Wahiba Arres was crowned as Miss Tunisie 2014 at the finals of the pageant held on April 6' 2014. She went on to represent Tunisia at Miss World 2014 pageant held in London, though remained unplaced at the finals.
Miss Tunisie 2015 is now scheduled for April 7' 2015.

pieces.title: Miss Tunisie
pieces.dek: Miss Tunisie (or Miss Tunisia) is the annual national beauty pageant in Tunisia, that is responsible for selecting the country's representative for Miss World and Miss International pageants. body: Miss Universe Australia pageant commenced in the Year 2004, when the first pageant was held. Jennifer Hawkins was the first ever winner of Miss Universe Australia pageant, and she also went on to win Miss Universe 2004 pageant. Miss Universe 2004, the 53rd Miss Universe pageant, was held in Centro de Convenciones CEMEXPO, Quito, Ecuador on June 1, 2004.
Jennifer Hawkins - Miss Universe 2004

Prior to winning the Miss Universe crown in 2004, the only time Australia went on to win Miss Universe pageant was in the Year 1972 when Kerry Anne Wells (Miss Australia pageant winner) was crowned Miss Universe 1972.
Kerry Anne Wells - Miss Universe 1972

The Miss World Fiji organisation has mirrored the efforts of the Miss World organization by creating a platform to assisting in the successful careers of its national finalists. body: The reigning titleholders dedicate their year to promote environmental projects and to address issues concerning the environment.

The Miss Earth Guam Organization was created to work with local youth and adults to participate in environmental issues and projects. The organization aims to foster Beauties for a Cause, a cadre of young leaders and ambassadors whose mission is to encourage both local and global communities through promoting awareness on the importance of preservation, protection, and care, for the environment.

tabs.label: Miss Earth New Zealand : Info
tabs.dek: Miss Earth New Zealand is a national beauty pageant of New Zealand that selects representatives for the Miss Earth beauty pageant.
body: The national franchise of Miss Earth New Zealand was launched in 2001 by Miss World New Zealand Ltd, under the directorship of Ros Taylor. In 2011, the New Zealand Asia Pacific Trust acquired the Miss Earth New Zealand franchise. Miss Earth New Zealand pageant is carried out to assure that each of the candidates are not just physically beautiful, but environmentally knowledgeable.
The winner of Miss Earth New Zealand not only represents the country at the Miss Earth beauty pageant, but also serves as the environmental ambassador for the country.

Miss Earth is an annual Beauty Pageant which is aimed at promoting Environmental Awareness. Carousel Productions organized and launched the first Miss Earth beauty pageant in 2001 to actively promote the preservation of the environment. Miss Earth is part of one of the Big Four International Pageants. Miss Earth is one of the most unique kinds of a beauty pageant which promotes the idea of ‘Beauty for a Cause’; all the contestants desiring to be crowned with the coveted title have to work for environmental and social causes and spread awareness.

pieces.title: Miss Earth New Zealand
pieces.dek: Miss Earth New Zealand is a national beauty pageant of New Zealand that selects representatives for the Miss Earth beauty pageant. Miss Earth New Zealand Pageant aims to - “Raise the awareness of environmental issues not only around the world but also those within New Zealand. And to furthermore, develop young leaders skills that help build, protect, and sustain New Zealand’s wildlife and eco-system”.

tabs.dek: Miss Universe New Zealand is an annual national beauty pageant that selects representative to the Miss Universe pageant.
body: The Miss Universe New Zealand pageant was created in the year 2006 after no delegates were sent to Miss Universe in 2004 and 2005. The country won its first Miss Universe title in the year 1983 under the representation of Lorraine Downes. The only Top 5 placement that the country has won was in the year 1980 when Delyse Nottle was titled second runner-up.

In 1962, 1981 and in 1992 New Zealand had three semi-finalists placements. New Zealand is one of only 12 countries to win two or more Miss Photogenic awards, won by Carole Robinson (1969) and Delyse Nottle (1980).
The winner of Miss Universe New Zealand winner enjoys a very busy and productive year-long long reign working with Miss Universe as well as Variety, the Children’s Charity.

A dynamic consortium, comprising veteran TV producer Nigel Godfrey, experienced make-up artist and well respected personal trainer Evana Patterson, and Lucire publisher Jack Yan, are a part of the Miss Universe New Zealand franchise and promise an exciting new competition.

tabs.label: Miss World New Zealand : Info
tabs.dek: Miss World New Zealand is an annual national beauty pageant in New Zealand established in 1951, that selects representatives for Miss World, Miss International, Miss Grand International, Miss Intercontinental and Miss Tourism International.
body: Miss New Zealand pageant abides by the axiom of Beauty with a Mission. The concept of Beauty with a mission is the heart and essence of the pageant. Following the objective of the Miss World Organisation, Miss World New Zealand decided to emulate the same and introduced the concept of charity and aids as the core basis of the pageant.

The pageant reached its peak in the year 1980, when the event was televised on TVNZ. From the year 2005-2007 no national pageant was held, however in 2007 an Auckland community trust bought the franchise and the pageant was held to select the country's representative to Miss World 2008 held in May 2008.
The winner of Miss World New Zealand goes on to represent New Zealand at the Miss World pageant.

The first runner-up of Miss World New Zealand represents her country at the Miss International. In the year 1960, New Zealand made a debut at the Miss International and won the first ever title in the year 1971.

The second runner-up of Miss World New Zealand represents her country at the Miss Intercontinental. The third runner-up represents at the Miss Tourism Queen International. New Zealand has never won any crown at the Miss Tourism Queen International, however, in the year 2009 Natalie Jean Sangster made it to the Top 20 finalists. And finally, the fourth-runner up goes on to represent New Zealand at the Miss Grand International pageant.
